Originally, the plan was to use the mutilated remains
to execute a trick that would further obscure the truth, but……
m200583.村の中を片っ端から調べてみたが、\nそちらが見つけた以上の手がかりは見つからなか:
I searched the village thoroughly, but
I didn't find anything beyond what you've already discovered.
m200583.根拠となるのは、やはりムア嬢の行動だ。: The key, as always, lies in Miss MuA's behavior.
m200583.案内するから、どうか確かめてみてほしい。\n私が見つけた代物をね。:
I will show you the way.
Please, go and check out what I found.
m200583.森の中で見つかった理由は、\n魔獣がそこまで引きずっていっただとかかな。:
As for why it was found in the forest,

perhaps the monsters dragged it there.
m200583.森の奥で、酷く物騒な物を見つけてしまってね。\n警察か衛兵に知らせなければと思っ:
I came across something rather dangerous deep in the forest.
I was thinking of alerting the police or the guards,
but since the Security Director is here, we can save some time.
m200583.森の獣たちが私たちに気づいたみたいね！: The forest beasts seem to have noticed us!
m200583.様々な推理が飛び出してきたが、\nとはいえそうなるのも仕方がないだろう。:
A wide variety of deductions have come up,
but that's hardly surprising, given the circumstances.
m200583.次は事件当日の昼間の様子を再現するから、\n夜が明けるまで、ゆっくり休んでくれ。: Next, we will reenact the daytime of the day the incident occurred, so please rest well until morning breaks.
m200583.正しい推理であれば、彼女は反応するだろうからね。: If the deduction is correct, she should react, after all.
m200583.正直、なんでもアリな気がするんだよね。: Honestly, it feels like anything could be true.
m200583.正解だよ、探偵殿。\n教え子から君たちの話を聞いて、\n直接会ってみたくなったも:
Correct, Detective.
I heard about you all from one of my students
and felt like meeting you in person.
m200583.死亡したのは、館の事件が起こったその瞬間であり、\nこれが『六人目の死体であるこ:
She died at the very moment the incident at the manor began,

and there's no doubt this is the sixth body.
m200583.死体となった者に犯行が不可能なら、\n殺害された六人は犯人たりえない。:
If the ones who became corpses couldn't have committed the crimes,
then the six who were killed cannot be the culprits.
m200583.死後しばらく経っていたことや、獣に齧られていたこと、\n腐敗していたことから、調: It was difficult to examine due to the time of death, animal bites, and decomposition, but……
m200583.沼地に到着したわけだが……。: So we've arrived at the swamp……
m200583.物騒な物、ね。\nなかなかどうして、気になるところではあるけど……。:
Something dangerous, huh.
It certainly piques my curiosity, but……
m200583.特定の入力をすることで、\nそれに対応した出力をする装置みたいに……。\nという:
It's like a device that produces a corresponding output
for a specific input……
Though that analogy might not make much sense outside the Steel Capital.
m200583.犯人に、そして真実に繋がる手がかりは、\nムアさんの反応の中にあるのではないでし:
Isn't the key to the culprit, and the truth,
hidden in Mua's reactions?
m200583.犯人に繋がる証拠がないから、\nどこに消えたのかも分からないのね。: There's no evidence linking us to the perpetrator, so we can't even guess where they fled to.
m200583.犯人に繋がる証拠がない以上、\n犯人を特定することはできず、\nまた、あらゆる推:
Since there is no evidence linking to the culprit,
we cannot identify them,
and we cannot rule out any of the deductions.
m200583.犯人は、「館の主人」「従者」「従者の友人」\n「主人の知人」「知人の妹」「来客」: The culprit was one of the following: the “Master of the Mansion,” the “Servant,” the “Servant's Friend,” the “Master's Acquaintance,” the “Acquaintance's Sister,” or the “Guest.”
m200583.犯人は、私が演じた役の人物だと思うの。: I think the culprit is the character I was playing.
m200583.犯人は、魔獣だった！\nどう、合ってる！？:
The culprit was the demonic beast!
Well? Am I right!?
m200583.犯人は私……つまり、「来客」だった。: The culprit is me… that is, the "visitor."
m200583.犯人は館に滞在していた何者かのようですが、\n証拠はほとんど残されておらず、\n:
The culprit appears to have been someone who was also staying at the mansion,
but almost no evidence was left behind,
and we were unable to identify them.
m200583.犯罪者という人種は、本当になんでも利用するな。\nそこまでして罪から逃れたいのか:
Criminals truly will use anything at their disposal.
How far will they go to escape justice?
m200583.王国の医者や癒し手に確認してもらったが、\nどうやら、間違いないようだ。: I consulted the kingdom's physicians and healers, and it seems the identification is correct.
m200583.王子、その推理を出した人物の前に、兵を配置してくれ。: Prince, please position your troops in front of the person who made that deduction.
m200583.王子ならもう気づいていると思ったが……。\nいや、被害者六名が犯人である可能性を: I thought you, Prince, would have noticed by now… Or perhaps you were trying to rule out the possibility that one of the six victims was the culprit first?
m200583.王子にどんな悪戯をしてあげようかって考えると、\n自然と楽しい気持ちになっちゃう:
Thinking about what kind of prank I can pull on the Prince
just naturally puts me in a good mood.
m200583.王子はつくづくお人好しだものね。\n断るなんて選択肢は、最初からなかったんでしょ:
The Prince is truly too kind.
Refusing was never really an option for you, was it?
m200583.王子？ そろそろ推理を選んで――: Prince? It's about time you made your deduction――
m200583.理解が早くて助かるよ。\nこればっかりは僕ひとりではやりようがないからね。:
I'm glad you caught on so quickly.
There's no way I could handle this on my own.
m200583.異様な状態だったので心配でしたが、\n少しでも心が休まったのなら、安心です。: I was worried given her condition, but I'm relieved to see she's finally getting some rest.
m200583.癒しの魔法の応用でなんとか……という話は今はいいか。: Let's leave the details about applying healing magic for later.
m200583.癒し手曰く、事件のトラウマを受け入れるために、\n心が過去を反芻し続けているよう:
The Healer says that, in order to accept the trauma of the incident,
her mind keeps ruminating on the past.
m200583.盗賊もとい「従者の友人」がそう言ったあたりで、\n騒ぎを聞きつけた「館の主人」と: It was around the time the bandits, or rather the "Servant's Friend," said that, that the "Master of the Mansion" and his "Servant" appeared, having heard the commotion.
m200583.真実を知っている目撃者がいる以上、\nその人物から答えを引き出すことさえできれば:
As long as there's a witness who knows the truth,
all we have to do is draw the answer out of them.
Even if the mystery isn't solved, the case can still be closed.
m200583.破壊って言ってるけど、\nつまりは、魔獣たちが食べちゃったってこと？:
You say “destroyed,” but
does that mean the magical beasts ate them?
m200583.確かに事件を生き延びた存在は二人いる。\nそのうちの一人は生存者の少女で――:
Indeed, there are two beings who survived the incident.
One of them is the girl known as the Survivor, and—
m200583.祝祭の日は覚悟してちょうだいね、王子。\n貴方にいっぱい、悪戯してあげるから。:
Just be on your guard on the day of the festival, Prince.
I'm going to play all sorts of pranks on you.
m200583.私、王子たちに助けてもらったこと、\n絶対に忘れないから。: I will never forget how the Prince and his team helped me.
m200583.私が犯人役だったんですね。: So, I was playing the role of the culprit.
m200583.私たちが貴様を逃がすと思っているのか？: Do you think we'd let you get away?
m200583.私とシェリンフォードさんたちは、\n誰かを演じることはありませんが……。\nヴェ:
Iroha and I won't be playing any roles, but……
I'll be by your side to assist with the reenactment.
m200583.私の周りには、素敵な人たちがたくさんいる。\nだから、なんにも苦しいことなんてな:
I'm surrounded by wonderful people.
So, there's nothing truly hard about my life.
m200583.私の推理が真実に繋がるのかしら……。: I wonder if my deduction leads to the truth…
m200583.私の推理ですか。\nふむ、そうですね……。:
My deduction, you say?
Hmm, I see……
m200583.私の推理ですか？\nあまり現実的ではないと思いますが……。: My deduction? I'm afraid it's a bit far-fetched…
m200583.私の生まれは、もっと遠いところだよ。\n色々あって故郷を離れなきゃいけなくなって:
I'm from much further away, actually.
Things happened, and I had to leave my hometown.
m200583.程々にしておけ。\n目的はあくまで撤退なのだからな。: Hold back. Our goal is a clean retreat, nothing more.
m200583.聞き方が悪かった、というわけじゃないわよね。: It's not like I phrased the question poorly, right?
m200583.腕が立つと噂には聞いていたが、\n君たちは噂以上のようだね。:
I had heard you were skilled,
but you seem to live up to the rumors and then some.
m200583.自分が貴族の血筋だと知ってからは、その地位と財産を\n手に入れたいと思うようにな:
Once he learned of his noble bloodline,
he became desperate to claim his status and wealth.
m200583.自分は都市議会直下治安局所属、\n局長のレストレインという者だ。\n事件解決のた:
I am Restrain, the Director of the Public Safety Bureau,
directly under the City Council.
I intend to do what I can to help resolve this incident.
m200583.色々あって忘れていましたが、\n私たちはまだまだ、やることがあるのでしたね。: We got so swept up in everything that we forgot, but we still have plenty to do.
m200583.行き倒れてた、ってことは……。\nムアはこの村で生まれ育ったわけじゃないの？:
Collapsed on the road……
Does that mean you weren't born and raised in this village, MuA?
m200583.行ってみる価値はありそうだけど、どうかしら？: It's worth a look, I think. What do you say?
m200583.行方が分からない誰かが犯人だ、って話だったよね？\nなのにそれが、他殺死体で見つ:
So, someone whose whereabouts are unknown is the culprit, right?

But if that person was found as a murder victim, then...
m200583.見知った顔がいてはりますなぁ。\nどうしたん？ 友達に迷惑かけにきたん？: I see a familiar face. What's the matter? Did you come to bother your friends?
m200583.証拠やアリバイなど、色々と根拠はあるが……。\nそれは『今回の話において重要では:
There is evidence, alibis, and various other grounds, but……
since that is "not important for this particular matter,"
I'll spare you the explanation.
m200583.証拠隠滅に利用したってこと――: So they were used to destroy evidence――
m200583.誰が犯人なのかは、まったく分からないままだよ……！: We still have no idea who the culprit is…!
m200583.誰が犯人なのか特定しなければ、\n彼女は続きの反応をしてくれないのだろうね。:
It seems she won't respond any further
until we identify the culprit.
m200583.誰の推理から聞くかは……王子、君に任せよう。: As for whose deduction to hear first… Prince, I'll leave that to you.
m200583.貴方は……鋼の都の探偵さんだったかしら。\nそれからそこにいるのは……。:
You are…… the detective from the Steel Capital, were you?
And the one with you is……
m200583.起きてっ！ 起きてよっ！\nお願い！ いやだ！ 起きて！ 起きてってば！！:
Wake up! Wake up!

Please! No! Wake up! I'm telling you, wake up!!
m200583.逃走経路は最初から確保していたようだね。\nこれだと追うことは難しそうだ。: It seems he had an escape route prepared from the start. It looks difficult to pursue him now.
m200583.郊外とはいえ、鋼の都で事件が起きたのですから。\n我々警備局が動かないわけにはい:
Even if it's on the outskirts, an incident has occurred in the Steel Capital.
We at the Security Bureau cannot simply stand by.
m200583.部下をこき使うのはやめたのかい――『教授』？: Have you stopped abusing your subordinates――"Professor"?
m200583.鋼の都の郊外の館。\nそこで起きたのは、殺人事件でございます。:
The incident took place at a mansion on the outskirts of the Steel Capital.
It was a murder.
m200583.間違っててもいいみたいなこと言ってたし、\n私の推理はこれでお願いね！:
You said it's fine if I'm wrong, so
please go with my theory!
m200583.隠れていたわけではないのだがね……。\nいや、失礼。怖がらせてしまったようで申し:
I wasn't hiding, exactly……
Oh, my apologies. I'm sorry to have frightened you.
m200583.頼りにしているわね。\nそれじゃあ、はじめましょうか。:
I appreciate that.
Well then, shall we begin?
m200583.顔は判別できないのですから、\n誰かが死体を用意して、死んだふりをしたとか、\n:
Since we can't identify their faces,
perhaps someone prepared the corpses and faked their deaths,
or something like that……
m200583.館で起きたあの痛ましい事件については、\nはじめからすべて知っていたからね。:
I knew everything about that tragic incident at the mansion
from the very beginning.
m200583.館にいたであろう者たち。\nそのうちの五名が被害に遭い、\n顔も分からぬような状:
The victims were the people who had been staying at the mansion.
Five of them were killed,
and their faces were mutilated beyond recognition.
m200583.館にいた六人を殺害したのは、\n飼育されていた魔獣だった、っていうのはどう？:
What if the one who killed the six people in the mansion
was the magical beast that was kept there?
m200583.館にいた存在の中に、犯人はいない、\nということになるのでしょうか……？:
Does that mean the culprit

wasn't among those in the manor...?
m200583.館にいた者たちは何者かによって殺され、\n散歩をしていたムア嬢だけが、犯人の魔の:
Those in the manor were killed by someone,

and only Miss MuA, who was taking a walk, escaped the culprit's clutches—
m200583.館には七人がいて、\nその中からムアさんを引いて、残りは六人。:
There were seven people in the mansion.
Subtracting MuA-san, that leaves six.
m200583.館に存在していた者に扮して、\n言葉を演じ、流れをなぞることで、\n彼女は『その:
By taking on the role of someone who was present in the mansion,
performing their words, and following the flow of events,
she will “act out her own behavior from that moment.”
m200583.館の事件の犯人は、ムアなる少女と同じでね。\n先代当主の隠し子だったのだよ。:
The culprit behind the mansion incident was, like the girl named Muar,
an illegitimate child of the former head of the house.
m200583.黒冠の力も与えてあげたというのに。\nいやはや、顧客が一人いなくなって残念だよ。:
I even gave him the power of the Black Crown.
I do wish I had another client to work with.
m200583.（まともに話せているように見えるけど……。\nこれは、過去の反応をしているだけな: (She seems to be speaking coherently, but…… this is just a replay of her past reactions, isn't it?)
m200583.（もしかして、あの方が……？）: (Could it be that that person is……?)
m200583.（事件の唯一の生存者にして目撃者。\n当時館で暮らしていた、ムアという少女だよ）: (The sole survivor and witness of the incident. She's a girl named MuA who was living at the mansion at the time.)
m200583.（以下間違い共通に合流）: (The following is a common merge point for incorrect answers)
m200583.（全然接点がなかった娘と友人のフリするの、\nなんか変な感じするわぁ……。\nま:
(Pretending to be friends with a girl I've never even met before…… it feels a little weird……
Well, she is a beauty, so I guess it's a bonus.)
m200583.（誰かのフリをするのって、なんか詐欺みたいだなぁ。\n私は盗賊だけど、こういうの:
(Pretending to be someone else feels a bit like a scam……
I'm a bandit, but I think I'm bad at this kind of thing.)
m200583.（都合よく動物が暴れてくれていると思っていたけど、\nこれも仕込みだったのね）:
(I thought the animals were just conveniently causing a ruckus,
but it seems that was part of the plan, too.)

m300241.――うむ、異変が起きたとなれば、\n王国ではその情報は王子のもとへ集まる。\n良: —Hmm, if an anomaly has occurred, the kingdom's reports will converge on the Prince. That's a sound judgment. So, what's the problem?
m300241.――さて、異界の門も安定した。\nそろそろ帰る時間じゃぞい。: —Well then, the otherworldly gate has stabilized. It's about time we head back.
m300241.――王子よ、急ぎ報告せねばならんことがある。\n例の異界の門の件じゃ。: Prince, I have an urgent report—about that otherworldly gate.
m300241.……この世界に、一緒に転がり落ちた子がいたんです。\nでも、さっき目が覚めたらど: …There was a child who fell into this world with me. But when I woke up a moment ago, they were gone… P-please, I beg you to find my companion!
m300241.……むっ？\nお嬢ちゃんや、迷子かな？\nここは王子の執務室じゃぞ？: …Hmm? Little girl, are you lost? This is the Prince's office, you know.
m300241.……行ってしまいましたね。\nどうしてでしょう、少し、名残惜しい気がします。: …They've left, haven't they? I don't know why, but I feel a bit reluctant.
m300241.あわわ……ありがとうございますっ！\nよ、よろしくお願いしますっ！: Ah… thank you! I—I'm looking forward to working with you!
m300241.あわわ……その王子様に用事があって……。\n信じてもらえないかもしれないのですが: Ah… I have business with the Prince... You might not believe me, but…
m300241.うむ、信じるしかあるまいて。: Indeed, we have no choice but to believe.
m300241.かつて異界召喚士が開いた門に、\n邪仙が妖術を施して再展開したのが、\n件の門で: It appears the gate the summoner once opened has been re-opened by the evil sage's sorcery—that must be the gate in question.
m300241.きっと、きっとまた会いましょうね……！: I'm sure, I'm sure we'll meet again…!
m300241.ごく短時間の展開だったとはいえ、\nもしかしたら異界の者が、\nこちら側に零れ落: Even though it was a brief event, it's possible that creatures from the other world have spilled over here—
m300241.それじゃあ王子、またどこかで会えるといいわね。: Well then, Prince, I hope we meet again somewhere.
m300241.それでは王子、此度の戦いお疲れ様でした！: Well then, Prince, thank you for your efforts in this battle!
m300241.ちょうどその件で話をしていたところじゃからな。\nして、お嬢ちゃんの名は？: We were just talking about that, actually. So, what's your name, little girl?
m300241.なるほど、世界各地で門が開いたことにより、\n全く異なる場所に召喚されてしまった: I see, so the gates opening worldwide caused them to be summoned to completely different locations.
m300241.ね、猫じゃないです！\nあの、呂布さんもお元気で……！！: Hey, I'm not a cat! And, Ryofu-san, stay well…!!
m300241.はぅ……もうお別れなんですね……。\n王子様、王国の皆さん、\nいっぱい助けても: Hah… so this is goodbye… Prince, everyone of the kingdom, thank you so much for all your help.
m300241.ふふ、こちらこそ。\nふざけた企みを阻止出来たし、\n何よりこの世界の将の戦いぶ: Heh, likewise. We thwarted that ridiculous scheme, and I got to see the General of this world in action, too.
m300241.わ、私……こことは違う世界から来たんです！: I… I'm from a different world!
m300241.問題は、あの門の展開が原因で、\n世界各地で、瞬間的に\n複数の門が開いた可能性: The problem is that the gate's activation may have caused multiple gates to open instantaneously worldwide.
m300241.妖天君の企みも気にかかりますが、\n異世界から呼び出されてしまった方々も心配です: While I'm concerned about Youten-kun's scheme, I'm also worried about those summoned from another world. Prince, why not lend them your help?
m300241.王国と蜀は、もはや同盟国と同義です。\n乱世をおさめるため、\n世界は違えど、共: The kingdom and Shu are now essentially the same as allies. To bring order to this chaotic age, though our worlds differ, let's work together.
m300241.王子、王国の皆、危機が迫った時には\nこの錦馬超を呼ぶといい。\n必ずや、盟友を: Prince, everyone of the kingdom, when crisis looms, just call upon this splendid Bachou. I'll surely come to aid my allies.
m300241.皆さん、邪仙との戦いでは、力を貸していただき、\n本当にありがとうございました。: Everyone, thank you so much for lending your strength in the battle against the evil sage.
m300241.私はあの、その、えぇと、ほ、ほと、鳳統です！\nあのっ、困ったことがあったら、\: I… I'm, uh, well… Houtou! …I heard the townspeople say that if you're in trouble, you should consult the Prince…

m300283.――あっ、こら待て！\n軍議の最中だぞ――って勝手に扉を開くんじゃない！: —Ah, hey, wait! We're in the middle of a council—so don't just go opening doors on your own!
m300283.――こっちも急ぎの用事なの。\nこほん。あなたが王子さまであってる？:
—I have urgent business too.
*Ahem.* Are you the Prince?
m300283.…………ありがとう。\nこの恩は絶対に返すからね。:
……Thank you.
I'll definitely repay this debt.
m300283.……異世界の妖怪、とな。\n王子、どうやらこの娘、\n此度の事情を知っておるよう:
…Monsters from another world, huh.
Prince, it seems this girl knows what's going on this time.
m300283.あの子は妖怪が人間と融和することを\nずっと危険視していたの。: She's always been wary of monsters integrating with humans.
m300283.お願い、王子さま。\nあの子を止めるために、力を貸して……！:
Please, Prince.
Help me stop her…!
m300283.けれど問題は、こちらへ押しかけてしまった、\n私の仲間たちの方ですね……。: But the real problem is my comrades who barged in here…
m300283.これからもきっと衝突することはあると思いますが、\nきっと、この世界で解決策は見: There will surely be more clashes ahead, but I'm confident we'll find a solution in this world.
m300283.それでは王子、\nさっそくヨユキさんの足跡を追いましょう！: Then, Prince, let's head straight after Yoyuki's trail!
m300283.それより、王国の力を貸してほしいの。\nあの子が――ヨユキが\n異世界の妖怪を喚:
More importantly, I need the kingdom's aid.
That girl—Yoyuki—seems to have summoned monsters from another world.
m300283.では、異世界交流ということで、\n演習場へ向かいましょうか。: Well then, as a sort of inter-world exchange, shall we head to the training grounds?
m300283.なるほど、それで異世界より、\n強大な力を持つ妖怪を喚び出したのか。: I see, so that's why she summoned such powerful monsters from another world.
m300283.ふふ、百妖夜行を名乗るとは、\nなかなかに剛毅なご友人ですね。: Heh, calling yourself the Hundred Monster Night March—what a steadfast friend you are.
m300283.グリムさんが門を開いてくれたことで、\nようやくこちらに来られたのです。\n……:
Thanks to Grimm opening the gate, I was finally able to get here.
…Please don't scold me too harshly, okay?
m300283.ヨユキは弱い妖怪たちが\n生きていけなくなることを心配しているだけなの。: Yoyuki is only worried that the weaker monsters won't be able to survive.
m300283.以前にも城娘さんとは交流があったので、\n皆さん驚くことなく受け入れてはいるので: We've dealt with the castle maid before, so everyone's accepted us without surprise, but…
m300283.仲良くなりすぎて、一緒に演習を\nしようなんて話になっているみたいね……。: Looks like we've gotten so friendly that we're even talking about training together…
m300283.仲間の内で競い合うのは重要なこと。\n皆がやる気だというのなら、\nこの江戸城も: Competing among comrades is important. If everyone's motivated, then Edo Castle will lend its strength as well.
m300283.助太刀が遅くなったこと、まずはお詫びします。\n本当はひとりでここへ渡るつもりだ:
First, I apologize for arriving late to assist.
I originally intended to come here alone, but crossing into another world proved too difficult…
m300283.妖怪が人間に受け入れられて、\n畏れを得られなくなったなら、\n弱い妖怪たちは滅: She thinks that if monsters are accepted by humans and lose their fear, the weaker ones will become extinct.
m300283.本当は私が止めるべきだけれど、\nあれだけの妖怪がついていたら、\nひとりではど: I should be the one to stop her, but with that many monsters around, I can't handle it alone…
m300283.江戸城さん、ありがとう。\nおかげでヨユキと話ができたわ。:
Edo Castle, thank you.
Because of you, I was able to talk to Yoyuki.
m300283.知っているも何も、この事件を\n起こしたヨユキは、私の昔の友だちだもの。: Whether she knows or not, Yoyuki, who caused this incident, is an old friend of mine.
m300283.私はレンゲ。\n旅の弓使いだとでも思っておいて。:
I'm Renge.
Just think of me as a traveling archer.

m300367.――では、本当に誰もお咎めなしで、\n騒動を起こした場所での\n奉仕活動だけを命: ——So, truly no one is being punished, and we're only ordered to do service work at the site of the disturbance.
m300367.――なるほど、蓮華たちが言っていた、\n異世界というのはこの世界のことだったの。: I see… so the “otherworld” Renka mentioned was actually this world.
m300367.――デモシェフ商会が、この騒動の中心……？: ——So the Demo Chef Guild is at the heart of this whole mess…?
m300367.――脅迫、いや、人質でしょうか。\nそうでもなければ、彼女が従うとは……。: ——Coercion, or perhaps hostages? If not that, why would she obey…?
m300367.あの後も色々あったがな。\n王国の者らも壮健なようでなによりだ。: A lot's happened since then. The kingdom folk seem vigorous, which is the best.
m300367.あれだけの荒くれ者を率いた上で、\n高い規律を保つ手腕、お見事としか言えません。: Leading such a band of ruffians while maintaining such strict discipline—truly impressive.
m300367.いえ、それはお互い様ですから。\n双方共に、怪我がなくて何よりです。: No, it's mutual. The fact that neither side was injured is what matters.
m300367.えぇ、その時にはぜひ。\n……あら？ そういえば他の皆さんは……。:
Yes, definitely then.
...Hm? Come to think of it, where is everyone else...?
m300367.おふたりとデモシェフ商会が、\n何かに巻き込まれている可能性が高そうですね。\n: It looks like you two and the Demo Chef Guild are likely caught up in something. Prince, let's stay on guard and head for the next town.
m300367.さすがに散らかした場所は\n片付けてもらわないといけないですからね。: Still, we'll have to clean up the mess they made.
m300367.そう言ってもらえると助かるわ。\n――改めて、私は孫堅が嫡嗣、孫策伯符よ。: I'm glad to hear you say that. —Once again, I am Sun Ce, heir of Sun Ken.
m300367.その上、最前線に立ってるのは呂布らしい。\nあいつ、そんなことするようなヤツには: On top of that, the one holding the front line seems to be Ryofu. He didn't look like the type to do something like that.
m300367.その線はありそうだ。\nさっきの賊も、こう言っていたから。: That angle seems plausible. The bandit we just talked to mentioned something like that.
m300367.それから、孫堅さんに、孫権さん。\nお久しぶりです！ 元気にしていましたか？: And Sun Ken, Sun Chuubou… Long time no see! How have you been?
m300367.それなら、王国に滞在してもらえば良いのでは。\nいわゆる食客というやつですよ。: Then why not stay at the kingdom? You could become a guest—what they call a “food guest.”
m300367.ちょーっと時間がかかりますねー。\n以前の門の残滓が原因で、\n偶発的に開いてし: That'll take a bit of time. The remnants of the previous gate caused it to open accidentally.
m300367.ですが、軽い処分となったのは董卓さんのおかげですよ？: And the lenient treatment is all thanks to you, Dong Zhuo.
m300367.では、私たちは、\n他に異世界から召喚されてしまった方がいないか、\n周辺の調査: Alright, then let's investigate the surrounding area to see if anyone else was summoned from the otherworld.
m300367.ないと言い切ることはできませんが、\n必ず、その背後には事情があるはずですね。: I can't say for certain, but there must be some reason behind it.
m300367.なるほど……。\n新たに帰還用の門をつくることは？: I see… what about constructing a new gate for returning?
m300367.へぅ……恋さんまで……。\nでもこれは、恋さんの強さを利用させてもらったからで…: …even Koi-san… but that's because we got to use Koi-san's strength…
m300367.まさか、また異世界にやってくるなんて、\n想像もしていなかったけれどね。: I never imagined we'd end up in another world again.
m300367.むしろ、勝手に門が開いた方が大問題ですねー。\nもしかすると、他にも巻き込まれた: Actually, an uncontrolled opening is a bigger problem. There might be others caught up in it.
m300367.んー……。\n挑戦的な実験としてなら使ってもいいですかねー。\n正直全然、安全が: Hmm… Could we use it as a daring experiment? Honestly, I can't guarantee it's safe at all.
m300367.グリムさん、異界の門の調査お疲れ様です。\nあの門は帰還に使えそうですか？: Grimm, thanks for investigating the otherworldly gate. Do you think we can use that gate to return?
m300367.デモシェフ商会も同様です。\n最初期こそ衝突も激しいものでしたが、\nそれは物質: The Demo Chef Guild is the same. In the early days their clashes were fierce, but that was just because they were unfamiliar with the material world.
m300367.ハッハッ、オレたちが王国の食客か。\n悪くねえな。\nついでに悪漢凶漢も蹴散らし: Ha ha, we're the kingdom's guests, huh? Not bad. I'll also kick out any scoundrels while I'm at it.
m300367.今の彼らは、むしろ魔王決戦で被害を受けた人々のために、\n様々な援助すらしている: These days, they're actually providing all kinds of aid to the people who suffered in the Demon King's battle.
m300367.共に戦った王国の猛者たちに剣を向けたこと、\n謝らなければいけないわね。: We have to apologize for turning our swords against the brave warriors of the kingdom we fought alongside.
m300367.呂布さんはそんなことしませんよ！\nちょっともふもふが激しいですけど、\nすっご: Ryofu would never do that! He's a little… overly fluffy, but he's an incredibly good person!
m300367.妹が、食文化も似ていると言っていたわね……。\nどうにも、華の国の文化は他人の気: My sister said the food culture is similar too… Somehow, the culture of Hua feels like someone else's.
m300367.姓は黄、名は蓋。字は公覆じゃ。\n以降見知りおくがいい。: My family name is Huang, given name Gai. My courtesy name is Gongfu. From now on, you can call me that.
m300367.孫策さんに、孫尚香さんに、黄蓋さん。\nやはり華の国と文化が近いのでしょうか。\: Sun Ce, Sonshoukou, Huang Gai… It seems the land of Hua shares a similar culture. Their names even sound familiar.
m300367.尋問した賊によれば、ですが。\nケーザイでテッペン――つまり、\n商業力で独立国: The bandit we interrogated said that they're aiming for the pinnacle of Kaizai—basically trying to build an independent nation through commercial power.
m300367.市民には被害を出さない、\n絶対に誰も殺さない、負傷者も最小限に留める……。\n: No civilian casualties, absolutely no killings, and keeping injuries to a minimum… that directive came from you, right, Dong Zhuo?
m300367.帰還が叶うのなら問題ないわ。\nただ、それまで雨露をしのげる場所を探さないと……: If we can return, that's fine. But until then we need to find shelter from rain and sun.
m300367.最前線に呂布、頂点に董卓。\nこれこそがケーザイセンソーのホーテーシキよ、ってさ: Ryofu on the front line, Dong Zhuo at the top—that's the hierarchy of the Kaizai Front, they said.
m300367.様子を見に行ってみましょうか。\n……何事もないといいのですが……。:
Shall we go check it out?
...I hope nothing's wrong...
m300367.次にお会いする時には、\nぜひ互いの世界の戦略を語り合いたいところですね。:
Next time we meet,
I'd love to discuss the strategies of our worlds.
m300367.異界の門の準備をしているはずですが……。\n……なにやら、玉座の間の方から、\n:
They should be preparing the portal to the other world...
...And it sounds like there's commotion coming from the throne room.
m300367.私は孫尚香！\n蓮華姉様がお話してた異世界、\n一度行ってみたいって思ってたんだ: I'm Sonshoukou! The otherworld Sister Renka talked about… I've always wanted to go there♪
m300367.自軍の兵力を正しく扱う、\nそれもまた将の才能というものでしょう。: Properly handling one's own troops is also a talent of a true general.
m300367.荒くれ者を率いて、\n各地で暴れまわってる原因、かぁ……。: So the cause of those ruffians leading a rampage across the lands, huh…?

m400373.さあ王子、『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Now, Prince, issue the Grand Annihilation Mission!
m400373.そのため出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないので\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者や、: Because deployment cost won't recover over time, be sure to include anyone with the “Request Reinforcements” skill or a Valkyrie in your sortie.
m400373.それでは、詳細についてご説明いたします。\n今回の戦いは敵を倒すことだけを目的と: Now, let me explain the details. This battle will be a “Grand Annihilation Mission,” focused solely on defeating the enemy.
m400373.それと、敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできません: Also, defeating enemies won't grant EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400373.まず大討伐ミッションは『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的となります。: First, the sole objective is to destroy the enemy.
m400373.ライフが０になってもクリアとなり\nそれまでに倒した敵の数がカウントされ\n戦果: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've slain will be recorded as your achievement.
m400373.傷つくことを恐れず、一体でも多くの魔物を\n倒すことに専念してください。: Fear not the wounds—devote yourself to cutting down every monster you can.
m400373.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは\nいくつか異なる点がありますので\nご注: The Grand Annihilation Mission differs from regular missions in several ways, so please take note.
m400373.奇襲に適した谷間の狭い道がございます。\nここで敵を迎え打ちましょう！: There's a narrow valley perfect for an ambush. Let's meet the enemy there and strike!
m400373.奇襲を成功させるため、敵に気づかれないように\n布陣しなければならないので、\n: To pull off the ambush, we must position our forces without alerting the enemy, which limits how freely we can deploy our troops.
m400373.女神アイギス様の力で強力な戦士たちが\n集まっているとはいえ、あの大兵力に\n正: Even with the powerful warriors gathered by the goddess Aegis, we have no chance of winning a frontal assault against such numbers.
m400373.思い起こすだけでもおぞましいですが、\nこれほどの大群は、王城が攻め落とされて\: Just recalling it is horrifying, but we haven't seen a force this large since the royal castle fell...
m400373.王子。悪い知らせがございます。\n魔物たちの大群が近くまで迫っております。: Prince, I have bad news. A massive horde of monsters is closing in on us.
m400373.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要です。: Rather than minimizing our own losses, the key is to slay as many foes as possible.

m400423.――王子、此度は貴国の協力によって\n我ら白の帝国と貴国とで行う合同軍事演習が\: —Prince, thanks to your kingdom's cooperation, we're able to carry out this joint military exercise between the White Empire and your nation without a hitch.
m400423.……さて。今回の演習においては\n普段の魔物討伐の任とは異なる\n『大討伐ミッシ: …Now then. For this exercise we'll use a format different from our usual monster-hunting missions—a “Grand Hunt Mission.”
m400423.そこで、今回はより一層の連携強化を図るべく、\n以前の演習に参加できなかった兵た: So this time, to further improve our cooperation, I'd like even the soldiers who couldn't take part before to gain combat experience alongside your troops.
m400423.それでは『大討伐ミッション』開始とさせて頂く！: Then, let the Grand Hunt Mission begin!
m400423.たとえライフが０になってもクリアとなり、\nそれまでに倒した数はカウントされ\n: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of foes you defeated is tallied as your battle record.
m400423.つまり、自軍の被害を恐れるよりも\n少しでも多くの相手を打ち倒す事に\n専念する: In other words, rather than worrying about your own casualties, you should focus on slaying as many enemies as possible.
m400423.まず大討伐ミッションでは\n『敵を撃破すること』\nそれのみが唯一の目的となる。: First, the only objective in a Grand Hunt Mission is to defeat the enemies.
m400423.また敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできない。\n: And defeating enemies won't grant EXP, gold, or any drops. Keep that in mind.
m400423.兎に角一人でも多く相手を倒す、\nそれこそが最も重要だ。: Simply put, the more opponents you take down, the better—that's what matters most.
m400423.其方も気を抜かずに相手をしてくれ。\n此度の演習も王国と帝国双方にとって\n意義: So don't let your guard down either. I hope this exercise proves valuable for both the kingdom and the empire.
m400423.出撃コストが時間経過で回復しない事も留意しておけ。\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ: Also note that deployment cost doesn't recover over time. Don't forget to include anyone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or a Valkyrie in your sortie team.
m400423.大討伐ミッションでは通常のミッションとは違い\n幾つか異なる点がある事に注意して: Keep in mind that a Grand Hunt Mission differs from a normal mission in several ways.
m400423.有事の際の連携を速やか且つ強固なものとするには、\n互いの戦力の把握が不可欠だか: For rapid and solid coordination in emergencies, we need to know each other's capabilities. I want you to use this chance to show your strength again.
m400423.演習とは言え、こちらは手を抜くつもりは毛頭ない。\n実戦と同等の緊張感をもって臨: Even though it's a drill, we have no intention of holding back. We must approach it with the same tension as real combat, or it won't be meaningful.
m400423.演習は帝国領内の軍事施設で実施することとなる。\n貴国の兵たちにも予めそう伝えて: The exercise will take place at a military facility within Imperial territory. Please inform your troops of this in advance.
m400423.過去に行われた合同演習では、\n我ら帝国軍と貴軍との連携強化を目標の一つに掲げ、: In past joint drills we set strengthening coordination with your forces as one of our goals, and I think we achieved that to some extent.

m400532.――ならば、私も出よう。\n協力者たる狭間の雪原の民から、\n死者を出すわけには:
—Then I'll go too.
We can't let the Rift's snowfield folk sacrifice any more lives.
m400532.――わかるぜ、この感覚は、おぼえてる。\n奴は、この俺がぶちのめす。: —I get it, I remember this feeling. He's the one I'll beat to a pulp.
m400532.――初めまして、ではないわね。\nさて、何と名乗ればいいかしら？: Well, this isn't exactly a first meeting. Now, what should I call myself?
m400532.――即応部隊を出すわ。\nここからの距離は？: —We'll send a rapid-response team. How far is it from here?
m400532.――王国の様子、また見てきたそうですね。: ——So you've come to see the state of the kingdom again.
m400532.……魔力嵐を突っ切って、\n調査部隊の救援に向かう、と。……王子が。: …pierce the mana storm and head to rescue the survey team. …the Prince will do it.
m400532.ああ、仮面の力のせいか、\n名前も顔も思い出せちゃいないが――: Ah, maybe because of the mask's power, I can't recall names or faces—
m400532.あとは、補給部隊の届かない\n敵地の真ん中に降りるから、『援軍要請』を持つクラス: From now on, we'll drop into the middle of enemy territory where the supply lines can't reach, so don't forget to bring classes with “Request Reinforcements” and the Valkyries in your formation, okay, kid.
m400532.あら、解説してくれるの？\n持つべきは親友ね。: Oh, you'll explain it? What I need is a close friend.
m400532.あら、誘ってほしかったの？\n愉快なカブカボパーティだったわ。:
Oh, you wanted me to invite you?
It was a delightful Kabukabo party.
m400532.あらあら、私まで巻き込まないでね？: Oh dear, don't drag me into this, okay?
m400532.えぇ、そうしてちょうだい。\n私の名前で、封印を解く儀式を。: Yes, please do so. Perform the sealing-breaking ceremony in my name.
m400532.えぇ、モリグナン。\n徹底的にやります。殺すつもりで。:
Yes, Morignan.
We'll be thorough. We'll kill them.
m400532.えぇ。でも、それを理解していながら、\nまたこの世界に干渉する気になってしまった: Yes. But even knowing that, you still feel like interfering in this world again—
m400532.お嬢様、出立の準備は整っております。\nユキヒツジの里の者が案内を申し出てくれま: Miss, everything's ready for departure. A person from the Village of Snow Sheep has offered to guide us.
m400532.ご存分に。\n公爵家の威名を、雪原にも轟かせてください。:
As you wish.
Let the dukes' name thunder across the snowfield.
m400532.さぁ？ 製作者にすら正体が分からなくなる、\nそれが私の魔術だもの。: Who knows? Even the creator loses track of its true form—that's my magic.
m400532.そういうの、あなたの悪い癖ですよ。\n魔女のくせに、気に入った者をすぐに信じるの:
That's your bad habit. 
For a witch, you trust those you like right away.
m400532.そしてもうひとつが――\n「現在襲撃を受けている。救援を求む」です。: And the other says— “We've spotted an enemy base.”
m400532.その「あの人」を取り戻すために、\n彼は契約を結んだようだけれど？: He apparently made a contract to get that “person” back?
m400532.それから、何人か儀式の補助を頼む。\nできれば英雄王に縁のある者と、\n馬の扱い: And ask a few people to assist with the ritual—preferably those linked to the Hero King, those skilled with horses, and those strong enough for heavy work.
m400532.それが、この魔女が編み上げた魔術なんですよ。\n時に自分自身すら、誰なのか認識で: That's the magic this witch weaves. It's a mask that can even make its own wearer forget who they are, distorting everyone's perception around them.
m400532.それじゃあ、あなたはこのまま\n彼の親子ごっこに付き合うつもりなのかしら？: So, are you going to keep playing along with his parent-child act?
m400532.それじゃあ、ここからは別行動ね。\nこちらも決戦の準備を整えましょう。: Then we'll split up from here. Let's also get ready for the final battle.
m400532.それじゃあ、注意事項を手短に伝えるよ。: Alright, I'll give you the brief rundown.
m400532.それで、どうするつもり？\n私はもう、あちらについてもいいのだけれど。:
So, what will you do?
I could go over there myself, you know.
m400532.それに――「あの人」は死んだんです。\nいまさら、それを無かったことにするなんて:
Besides—“that person” is dead.
Trying to pretend it never happened now isn't a proper ending.
m400532.そんな感想はどうでもいいです。\nそれで、どうでしたか？:
That kind of impression doesn't matter.
So, how was it?
m400532.ただひたすらに前を向いて、\n誓いを胸に、友と歩み続ける子たち。\nまるで、昔の:
Just constantly looking forward,
with vows in their hearts, walking with friends.
Just like us back then, you know.
m400532.つ、使えない……！\n本当は知ってるんじゃないですかぁ？: I—can't use it…! You really do know, don't you?
m400532.では、皆さまドーンブリンガーへ乗艦を。\nこれより友軍の救援へ向かいます！: Alright, everyone, board the Dawn Bringer. We're heading out to aid our allies!
m400532.では私も。\n敵戦力が不明だというのなら、\n戦力はひとりでも多い方が良いでしょ:
Then I'll join as well.
If the enemy strength is unknown, isn't it better to have as many of us as possible?
m400532.どうしたの、オーシェン。\nあなたらしくもない焦り方ね。何が起きたの？:
What's wrong, Oshen?
That's not like you, all flustered. What happened?

m920003.フフフッ、初めまして王子様方？\n出会ったばかりですが…\nあなたたちを倒します: Hehehe, nice to meet you, Your Highnesses. We just met, but I'm going to defeat you!
m920003.再び魔女たちが集結し始めたとの情報を\n入手しました。\nどんな魔物が出てくるか: We've received word that the witches are gathering again. Whatever monsters show up... stay on your guard.
m920003.本来、魔女は気まぐれでわがまま…\n協力して戦うような人たちではないのですが\n: Normally witches are capricious and selfish—not the type to cooperate in battle—but perhaps a strong leader has emerged.
m920003.村人たちによると夜な夜な魔物たちが現れ\n住人をさらっていくとの話です。: The villagers say monsters appear every night, snatching residents away.
m920003.白い魔女……。\n以前、どこかでみたような……。\n王子、覚えていますか？: The White Witch... I feel like I've seen her somewhere before... Prince, do you remember?
m920003.魔女の追手です。振り切りましょう！: They're witch pursuers. Let's shake them off!
m920003.魔物の襲撃！？ 罠です！\nどうやら待ち伏せされたようです。: An ambush! It's a trap! Looks like we've been ambushed.

m920034.あたしの山賊団は無くなったけど、\n他の山賊団の人と一緒に戦えば\nどこかにチャ: My gang's gone, but if we team up with other bandits, there should still be a chance somewhere!
m920034.あの人を倒せば山賊王になれる。\nでも……、私一人じゃ……。:
If I take that person down, I can become Bandit King.
But… I can't do it alone.
m920034.あんたたちのせいで\nあたしの山賊団がバラバラに\nなっちまったじゃねえか。: Because of you, my bandit gang fell apart, didn't it?
m920034.いいかお前ら！\nここにロロネ山賊団を結成する！: Alright, you lot! From now on, this is the Rorone Bandit Gang!
m920034.うぅ……山賊王への道が……。\nあたしの野望が……。:
Ugh… The road to becoming Bandit King…
My ambition…
m920034.うぉおーーーッ！\n頭なら絶対なれますぜ！\nおれたちついていきますぜ！: Whoa—! If it's the leader, we'll definitely become it! We're with you!
m920034.うん……。\n一人じゃない……！\n私にはこんなに仲間がいる。:
Yeah…
I'm not alone…!
I have so many allies.
m920034.うん、いい感じになってきたぞ。\n肉を切らせて骨を断つ。\nこれが山賊流の戦い方: Yeah, it's getting better. Slice the flesh, break the bone. That's the Bandit way of fighting.
m920034.おっと。ここに来た山賊たちも戦いを\n見るだけじゃ面白くねえだろ？\n最後のチャ:
Hey, the bandits who came here aren't just watching for fun, right?
I'll give you a final chance.
m920034.お嬢、王子がきましたぜ。: My lady, the Prince has arrived.
m920034.ここでお前を倒して、名を上げてやる！: I'll take you down here and make a name for myself!
m920034.この儀式で王子を倒した者は\n山賊王を名乗っていいってのはどうだ？: How about this: whoever defeats you in this ceremony can call themselves the Bandit King.
m920034.この場所に呼んだのは他でもねぇ。\n山賊王になるための最後の儀式をやるためだ。: The reason I called you here is none other than to perform the final ceremony to become Bandit King.
m920034.この大乱戦の中なら、王子にも隙が生まれるはず！\nライラさんから教えてもらった\:
In this massive melee, even the Prince will have an opening!
Lyra taught me the “reckless charge” to knock the Prince out!
m920034.これが海賊の戦いか！\n弾丸が飛び交っててあぶないなー！:
So this is a pirate battle!
Bullets are flying everywhere—dangerous!
m920034.さぁ、野郎ども！ 出陣よ！\nそこらの海賊団とは鍛え方が\n違うって所を見せてあ: Come on, you bastards! To battle! Show them how we train differently from those pirate crews!
m920034.さっそくですが頭、\n金目の物もってそうな一団が\nこっちに向ってきてますぜ。: Right away, boss, a party that looks like they're carrying loot is coming toward us.
m920034.すげー！！\nあれが聖霊の友って言われている\nセリアさんかー！: Wow!! That's the one they call the Holy Spirit's friend—Seria!
m920034.せっかくの祭りだ……。\n派手にいかねぇとなッ！: Since it's a festival… we've got to make it flashy!
m920034.そいつを倒さなきゃ、\n山賊王はそいつに譲るってな。: If you can't take him down, the crown goes to him.
m920034.そういうわけだからちょっと本気、\n出させてもらうわね。: So that's why I'm going to give it my all now.
m920034.そこで頭にきた俺は、\nそんなに山賊王になりたけりゃ\n俺の見込んだ男を倒してみ: That got me fired up, so I told them, if you really want the Bandit King title, try taking down the man I've got in mind.
m920034.だが魔物が復活し、多くの国が滅んでいるこんな\n時に山賊同士が戦うってのは俺とし: But with monsters resurfacing and countless nations collapsing, I don't want bandits fighting each other right now.
m920034.だもんで、山賊たちに延期する形で説得しようと\nしたんだが……。: So I tried to convince the bandits to put it off…
m920034.とほほ……。\nせっかく結成した山賊団が……。: *sigh*… We finally formed the gang, and now…
m920034.なぁに心配はいらないよ。\n魔物たちは王子がやってくれるさ。\nあんたは特訓に集: No need to worry. The monsters will fall to you, Prince. Just focus on your training.
m920034.なかなか手強い相手みたいだな。\nよし、お前たち。このあたしにまかせろ！: They're a pretty tough opponent. All right, you guys. Leave it to me!
m920034.はいっ！ 今度こそ王子をたおして、\n山賊王になるんだーーーーっ！！: Yes! This time I'll bring down the Prince and become the Bandit King!!
m920034.はっ！ いや、落ち込んでいる場合じゃない。\nこれは山賊王になるための試練なんだ:
Hah! No, this isn't the time to be depressed.
This is a trial to become Bandit King.
But first we have to get stronger… right.
m920034.ひぃーーーっっ！！\nこんな強ぇ奴らに勝てる訳ねぇ！\n逃げろーーーーー！！: Aaah—! We can't possibly beat these strong guys! Run!!!
m920034.まだだ！ 斧の振りが遅い！\nそんな弱腰じゃだめだ！\n心のまま、力のまま振りぬ: Not yet! Your axe swing's too slow! You can't be so weak! Swing with your heart, swing with your strength!
m920034.もう！ お嬢って呼ばないでってば！\n何度も言わせないでよ！: Stop calling me “my lady”! I've told you a hundred times!
m920034.もちろん俺が見込んだ男ってのはあんただ。\nさぁ、これから忙しくなるぜ？\nなに: Of course, the guy I have in mind is you. So brace yourself—things are about to get hectic. You'll be up against bandits from across the realm.
m920034.ようやく自分の山賊団を持てるようになったんだ。\n自分の山賊団を持ったら\n次に: Finally I've got my own gang. Now that I do, there's only one thing I'm aiming for…
m920034.よぉし、あの王子を倒すことが\n山賊王への近道だ！\nやってやるぞおおお！！！:
Alright, defeating that Prince is the shortcut to becoming Bandit King!
I'll do it!!!
m920034.よぉし、燃えてきた！\nそこの旅の人たち覚えてろよ！\n次会う時はぶっ飛ばしてや:
Alright, I'm fired up!
Travelers, remember this!
Next time we meet, I'll blow you away!!
m920034.よし！ 特訓終了だ！\nこれであんたもあたしと同じように\n「捨て身」の攻撃がで: All right! Training's over! Now you can make that reckless attack just like me.
m920034.よっし！ じゃあ王子には悪いけど\n倒させてもらおうかな！\n行くよ！ 野郎ども: Alright! Sorry, Prince, but we're going to take you down! Here we go, you bastards!
m920034.よーし、ロロネ山賊団の初仕事だ！\nお前たちかかれーーっ！: Alright, the Rorone Bandit Gang's first job! You, go for them!
m920034.んで、ここからが本題なんだが……。\n実は今年が、その新たな山賊王を決める年なん: So here's the deal… It turns out this year is the year we decide on a new Bandit King.
m920034.ロロネ山賊団の頭で一番強く！\nいずれ山賊王になる\nこのあたしが相手だ！: I'm the strongest leader of the Rorone Bandit Gang! I'll be the Bandit King someday—I'm your opponent!
m920034.一射で複数の敵を貫く私の愛銃！\nこの弾丸の嵐から逃れる者はなし！\n轟け！ 神:
My beloved gun that pierces multiple enemies in a single shot!
No one can escape this storm of bullets!
Roar! Divine gun Bryunak!!
m920034.今が手を取り合うときです。: Now is the time to join hands.
m920034.俺たち山賊の間には30年に一度、\n山賊たちの王、つまり山賊王を\n決めなきゃな: Every thirty years, we bandits have a rule that we must pick a Bandit King.
m920034.俺の任期が切れただの、老いぼれだのと\n言いたい放題言いやがる！: They're running their mouths, saying my term's up and calling me an old geezer!
m920034.俺の顔を立てると思って、山賊たちに\nあんたの力を見せつけてくれ！: If you want to keep my reputation intact, show the bandits what you can do!
m920034.前に戦ったあの人が、コンラッドさんの\n言っていた山賊王の候補……。\nどおりで:
That person we fought before is the candidate Conrad mentioned for Bandit King…
No wonder they're so strong.
m920034.山賊たちは魔物との戦いで戦力になるはずだ。\nあんたにも悪い話じゃねぇはずだ。: Bandits will be a force against the monsters, so it shouldn't be a bad deal for you.
m920034.山賊の中の王、\n山賊王にあたしはなるっっ！: I'll become the king among bandits—the Bandit King!
m920034.山賊王の肩書きに興味はないと思いますが、\n襲ってくる以上、迎撃するしかありませ:
I doubt you care about the title of Bandit King, but since they're attacking, we have no choice but to intercept.
Prince, please ready for battle.
m920034.山賊王は、その時代で一番強ぇ山賊が\nなるってことになってんだ。: The Bandit King is whoever's the strongest bandit of the age.
m920034.次期山賊王は、現山賊王より力がある所を\n皆に見せなきゃならねぇ。\nってことで:
The next Bandit King has to show everyone he's stronger than the current one.
So, I'm going to fight you right now.
m920034.王子……倒す……。\n山賊王……俺が……なる……！:
Prince… I'll defeat you…
Bandit King… I will become…!
m920034.王子、あのお二方は……\n何をされているのでしょうか？: Prince, what are those two doing…?
m920034.王子、あの二人から\n凄まじい殺気を感じます。\nご注意ください！！: Prince, those two are radiating an intense killing intent. Be careful!
m920034.王子、この場所を覚えているか。\n俺たちと最初に戦ったこの地を！:
Prince, do you remember this place?
The very ground where we first fought!
m920034.王子、ごめんね。\nでも可愛い妹の望みなのよ。\nだから私、妹を山賊王にしてあげ: Prince, I'm sorry. But it's my cute little sister's wish. I want to make her the Bandit King.
m920034.王子、山賊王就任の儀式を\nここで行うからと呼ばれましたが、\nなにが始まるので: Prince, I was summoned here for the Bandit King inauguration ceremony, but… what's about to begin?
m920034.王子は聖霊たちに気を取られている……。\nこのチャンス、逃さねぇ！: The Prince is distracted by the Holy Spirits… This is our chance, we won't miss it!
m920034.王子を倒すには最初から\n全力で行かないとね！\n行っくよーー！: To defeat the Prince we have to go all-out from the start! Let's go!!
m920034.王子を倒せば山賊王になれるって\n話だからあんたたちを集めたんだよ？\nちゃんと: I gathered you because if we defeat the Prince we can become the Bandit King. Fight properly, okay?
m920034.王子様……！\n聖霊さんたちと共にあなたを倒します。\nお覚悟を……！:
Prince…
Together with the Holy Spirits, we'll defeat you.
Prepare yourself…!
m920034.王子！ 山賊たちに全て勝利したようだな！\n流石、俺が見込んだ通りの男よ！:
Prince! Looks like you've defeated all the bandits!
Just as I expected, you're the man I counted on!
m920034.私、やります！\n聖霊さんと一緒なら\n何でもできる気がします！:
I'll do it!
With you, Holy Spirit, I feel like I can do anything!
m920034.私たちに有無も言わさず\n山賊の標的にされてしまいましたね……。: Without asking us, they've made us their targets…
m920034.良く頑張ったね。\nさて、いい感じに魔物も減ってるみたいだし\n早速、実戦で試し: You did great. The monsters are thinning out, so let's test it in real combat.
m920034.落ち込まれている所すみません。\nあなたが先ほど襲ってきた\n山賊団のお頭さんで:
Sorry to catch you when you're down.
Are you the leader of the bandits we just attacked?
m920034.行ってしまわれました……。\nなんだったのでしょう？:
She's gone…
What was that all about?
m920034.話は聞いてるよ。王子を倒せば\n山賊王になれるんだろ？: I've heard the story—defeat the Prince and you become the Bandit King, right?
m920034.頭……。いい響きだ……。: Boss… That has a nice ring to it…
m920034.魔物！？ このタイミングに\n出てくるなんて！\n王子、戦闘の準備を！: A monster?! At a time like this! Prince, get ready for battle!

m920088.――あれが前回魔界武術大会優勝チーム。\n……成程、流石の実力者揃い。特に彼らを: ???: —That was the team that won the last Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament. …I see, a lineup of top-class fighters. Especially the Prince's skill in leading them—truly impressive.
m920088.――お、遅くなってごめんなさい！\nちょっと道に迷っちゃって……。:
――Sorry I'm late!
I got a bit lost on the way…
m920088.――おはようございますリンさんっ！\n今日は新人の子を連れてきましたよっ！\n一: —Good morning, Rin-san! I've brought a rookie today! They want to do the morning training together!!
m920088.――まだです！ まだ息を吐いてはいけません！\n何事があろうとも、呼吸を乱さない:
――Not yet! Don't exhale yet!
No matter what happens, keep your breathing steady!
…Haa!
m920088.……お、穏やか……。\nこの性格は自分では嫌なのです！\n早く自分を変えたくて…: …Gentle… I hate that side of me! I want to change it quickly…
m920088.……くっ、なんという熱気……\nこれ以上は体が…………！: ...Ugh, this heat... I can't go on any longer!
m920088.……けどよ、手助けしたって\nベストラは喜ばないと思うぜ。いざって時は\nすぐに: …But I doubt Bestla'd appreciate any help. Still, we should be ready to jump in the moment it counts.
m920088.……そうですね。\n悪い方ではなさそうです。王子、\n一度お話を聞いてみてはいか: …That's true. They don't seem bad. Prince, why not hear them out?
m920088.……ただ、普通の人に\nこの訓練が耐えられるかどうか。: …the question is whether an ordinary person can endure this training.
m920088.……だめですね……あの時の感覚を\n呼び起こす事ができません。: ...No, I can't… I can't bring back that feeling from back then.
m920088.……どうか、どうかお願いします。\n私に稽古をつけては頂けませんか！:
…Please, please, I beg you.
Will you train me?
m920088.……なんだ、またゴブリンかよ。\nこう毎日毎日ゴブリンばっかじゃ、\n剣が鈍っち:
…What, another goblin again.
If it's goblins every single day,
my sword's going to get dull…
m920088.……なんだか周りも楽しそうだねぇ。\nそれじゃ、こっちも始めるとするかね。\n行: …Seems everyone's having fun. Well then, let's get started. Here we go!
m920088.……へ、兵士さん起きて……起きてください……\n…………でも……私も、もう……\:
…S-Sir… Soldier, please wake up… please…
……but… I'm also…
…faint…ing…
m920088.……む、あれは王子か？\nこれは幸運だ。我々も\n熱き戦いに興じようではないか！: …Hmm, is that the Prince? What luck. Let's join the heated battle ourselves!
m920088.……大丈夫、慣れている？ なるほど、\n確かに王子程の相手であれば\nオーク族の:
…It's okay, are you used to this? I see,
indeed, someone of your caliber, Prince, no orc would just leave you alone.
m920088.……実は、私はオークの力の源である\n「怒り」の力を他のオーク程\nうまく引き出:
…Actually, I can't draw out the power of “anger,” the source of an orc's strength,
as well as the other orcs can.
m920088.……敵意はないようですが、\n突然襲いかかってくるのは感心できませんね。\nまず: …They don't seem hostile, but I can't admire someone who just ambushes us out of the blue. Why don't you at least introduce yourselves?
m920088.……王子、話を聞いてくれた事\n感謝致します。:
…Prince, thank you for hearing me out.
I am grateful.
m920088.……！ は、はい！\n皆さん、救護の用意を！: …! Yes! Everyone, prepare the medical aid!
m920088.あ、あぁっ！ あれは以前の……！: Ah, ahh! That was… from before!
m920088.あ、アリスも来たわね。これで今日の\nモンク全員の合同練習のメンバーは\n全員揃: Ah, Alice is here too. Looks like we've got the whole monk squad assembled for today's joint training.
m920088.あぁあんたか。話は聞いてるぜ、\nオークにしては珍しく\n冷静で良い奴なんだって: Ah, it's you. I've heard the rumors—you're unusually calm for an ork, a good guy.
m920088.あの、ベストラさん本当に大丈夫ですか？\n以前訓練の一環として我々が参加した際は: Um, Bestla-san, are you really okay? The last time we took part in that training, we could barely walk the next day…
m920088.あの力が使いこなせれば、きっとあの人にも……\nアナトリアにも勝機はあるハズなん: If I could master that power, I'm sure there'd be a chance… for that person… and even Anatolia.
m920088.ありゃ、闘志が消えていっちゃった。: Looks like the fighting spirit just vanished.
m920088.いい感じだが、まだまだ力を使いこなせていない\nみたいだね……お前はそこで少し休: Not bad, but you still haven't mastered your power yet… Why don't you take a break over there?
m920088.いえ、お気になさらず。\nベストラさんの力をお借りできるのであれば、\nこちらと: No, don't worry about it. If we can count on Bestla's strength, that's a welcome thing for us too.
m920088.うーん……オークは\nあたし達人間とは違うしね。\n怒りの力なんて教えようもない:
Hm… Orcs aren't like us humans.
We can't really teach them the power of anger…
m920088.うーん、私の活丹法は本来一時的にしか出せない力を\n特別な呼吸法によって継続的に:
Hmm, my breathing technique can turn a normally fleeting burst of power into a sustained output.
We could give it a try, but…
m920088.ええ、大歓迎よ！ \nこっちこそよろしくね！！:
Of course, you're more than welcome!
Likewise, looking forward to it!!
m920088.えっ？\n別にいいけど……いいの？\nすっごくきついよ？: Huh? It's fine, but… really? It's super hard!
m920088.お、おい、オークの連中\nこっちに向かって来てやがるぞ！: Hey, those Orcs are coming straight at us!
m920088.お？ 王子達がここに来るなんて\n珍しいじゃない。どうかしたの？: Oh? It's rare to see the Prince and his crew here. Something wrong?
m920088.く……！ ここでくじけちゃダメだ……！\n絶対に……！ \nううぅおおおおおおお: No... I can't give up now... I won't...! Aaaaargh!!!
m920088.くそ、やっぱり勝てないか……。\nでも、でも……最後まで、\n最後まで戦うんだ！: Damn, I still can't win… But… I'll fight till the very end!
m920088.くっ…………やはり……私ではオークの\n頂点になど立てないのでしょうか……\n…: Damn… I guess I can never become the top of the orcs… Even my anger power is useless…
m920088.くっ………やっぱり強い……。\nたった一撃受けただけでこの衝撃……。: Damn… she's still strong… One hit and this shock…
m920088.くっ……流石にやりますね。\n参りました、降参です。: ???: Damn… they really are something. I'm impressed, I surrender.
m920088.ぐッ！ ……やるじゃないか。\n今のは良い一撃だったよ。けどまぁ、\n今回はこの: Guh! …Not bad. That was a solid hit. But… let's call it a day for now.
m920088.けど、そんなガタガタした御託や理屈なんて\nどうでも良いだろう。オークにとっては: Anyway, all that whining and logic doesn't matter. To an orc, strength is everything. Strength is justice.
m920088.けど、怒りの力って割りには全然そんな\n感じがしないね。凄い闘志なのに怒り任せじ: But for a rage power, it doesn't feel like that at all. It's a fierce fighting spirit, yet not reckless anger… It feels calm, warm even.
m920088.ここね、魔物達が現れてるって場所は。\nさぁみんな、行きますよ！:
Here's the spot where the monsters have appeared.
Alright everyone, let's go!
m920088.こっちこそよろしく！\nアナトリアさんと戦う時はいつでも呼んでよね！\n絶対応援: Same here, thank you! Whenever you're fighting Anatolia, just call me! I'll definitely come to support!
m920088.こんな所だからこそ、磨ける力もあるんだよっ！\nあたし達のラッシュは、ここで\n: That's exactly why we can sharpen our power here! Our rush attacks only come out when we forge our fighting spirit in places like this!
m920088.さ、流石に止めた方が良いんじゃない！？\nあれだけの猛攻を、息を止めたまま\n凌: Come on, we really should stop this, right?! Trying to endure that massive onslaught while holding your breath is just insane!?
m920088.しかし所詮ゴブリン程度では実力の底は\n見えませんね……まずは挨拶代わり、\n手: ???: But you can't gauge their true strength just by facing goblins… Let's start with a greeting—how about a sparring match?
m920088.す、すげぇ……なんつー闘志だ。\nこれが……！: Wow... that's some serious fighting spirit. This is...
m920088.す、すごい。皆さんがこれ程までに\n過酷な特訓をこなしていたなんて……\nこれで: Incredible. I never imagined everyone could endure such harsh training… With this, winning the Demon-World Martial Arts Tournament makes perfect sense!
m920088.すごいですねぇ。自分はようやく見張りを\n交代したところで……ふわぁ～～～。\n: Amazing… I just finally finished swapping the night watch… *sigh*… No wonder a shift that lasts until morning is so tough.
m920088.そうだ、紹介しておかないと！\nアリスさん、今日は\n新しい仲間を連れてきてるん:
Right, I should introduce you!
Alice, you brought a new comrade today!
m920088.そうだ。ここの溶岩地帯では、\n体力が徐々に奪われていっちまう。: Yeah. In this lava zone, your stamina just keeps draining away.
m920088.そうだ！ 折角きたんだし、王子も\n特訓に付き合って行ってよ。熱さで倒れないよう: That's right! Since you're here, Prince, join the special training with us. Don't let the heat knock you down—be careful! Alright, let's go!
m920088.そうなのか。私も力だったら結構自信あるよ。: Is that so? I'm pretty confident in my own strength, too.
m920088.そうなんだ～。私は良いと思うけどなぁ。\nそれにしても……今日はすっごい疲れたし: I see… I think it's fine though. Still, I'm exhausted today, and tomorrow's morning drill with Rin looks tough.
m920088.そっか。わかった！\nそれじゃ、明日も一緒に頑張ろうね！: Got it. Then let's both give it our all tomorrow!
m920088.そのような心持ちでは\nいざと言う時に王子を守り抜けなくて困りますよ。\n敵が向: With that attitude, you won't be able to protect the Prince when it counts. The enemy's coming—stay sharp!
m920088.その甲斐あってですかね。格闘大会では連戦連勝、\n今では並みのオーク族では相手に:
Perhaps that's why, in the fighting tournament I won match after match,
and now I'm so strong that ordinary orcs can't even challenge me.
But…
m920088.それがですね、ベストラさんが\nジーナさん達の修行を見たいと仰られるもので。\n: Well, Bestla asked to watch your training, so we brought you all the way out.
m920088.それじゃベストラ、\nあの太陽に向かって、\nもうひとっ走りいきましょうか！:
Then Bestla,
let's run one more lap toward that sun!
m920088.それじゃ王子、いつも通り走り込みのあとの\n組手はお願いするわ。\nそれじゃ皆、: Then Prince, after the run, handle the sparring as usual. Everyone, let's go!
m920088.それで、王子達に頼みたい事\nなのですが……: So, there's something I'd like to ask of you and the others…
m920088.それでもあの人……オーク族最強の戦士アナトリアには\n全く敵いませんでした。圧倒:
Even so, that person… Anatolia, the strongest warrior of the orcs,
couldn't be beaten at all. The overwhelming gap in power
shattered my pride mercilessly…
m920088.それと改めて、急に襲い掛かった事の\n非礼を詫びさせて下さい。申し訳ありません。: And also, let me apologize again for the rudeness of suddenly attacking. I'm sorry.
m920088.それにしても、本当に熱い地ですね。\nどんどん体力が奪われてしまいます……。\n: Still, this place is scorching. It's draining our stamina fast... There's no need to train in a spot like this...
m920088.それはそうですよ！ 魔界武術大会の\n長い歴史の中、かつて人間が優勝した事なんて: That's right! In the long history of the Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament, a human has never won even once!
m920088.それは判るけどよ……魔界武術大会の時、\nすげー連中と戦えたせいかなぁ。\nなん: I get it, but… maybe because I fought those crazy guys at the Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament, I've gotten a bit complacent…
m920088.それほどまでに過酷な朝練……聞いてただけで\n震えが……武者震いが止まりませんね: Such brutal morning training… just hearing about it makes me tremble… I can't stop shaking!! Exactly what I've been hoping for!
m920088.そんなんじゃダメよ！ ゴブリンだからって、\n舐めてかかったら痛い目を見る！:
That won't do! Just because they're goblins,
underestimate them and you'll get hurt!
m920088.そんな偉業をなした人達なら、\nきっと私を変えてくれるに違いない。\nそう思い、: If those who achieved such feats are here, they'll surely change me. That's why I came.
m920088.ちょうどいい機会ね。\nあなた達も一緒に走り込みよ！: Perfect timing. You all join the run too!
m920088.ですが、私の今の力はまだまだ未熟。\n皆さんの下、まだまだ鍛錬を\n積ませて頂け: But my current strength is still raw. I'd like to keep training under all of you… Please continue to look after me!
m920088.なぜかは分かりません。\n生まれつきなのかなんなのか……\n気づいた時からそうで:
I don't know why.
Whether it's innate or what…
It's been that way since I realized it.
m920088.にゅ、入門ですか？\nそういわれましても、\n軍は道場ではありませんし……。: Huh, join us? Even so, the army isn't a dojo…
m920088.は……はい！ いつか、いつかあなたを\n超える日まで頑張りますので！！ \nまた: Y-yes! I'll keep pushing until the day I surpass you!! And, please, let's keep working together!!
m920088.はい、私はオークとしてまだまだ未熟。\n皆さんの下で鍛錬を積めば、きっとあの人に: Yes, I'm still inexperienced as an orc. If I train under you all, I'm sure I can become someone worthy… Please, may I join the Prince's army?
m920088.はい。ベストラさん……どうか\n心行くまで戦ってください……！\nもし倒れても、: Yes. Bestla… please fight as long as you can…! If you fall, we'll rescue you right away!!
m920088.はん、そんな事あたしは知らないよ。怒りだの\nなんだの、そんなもん意識した事一度: Huh, I don't know about that. I've never cared about anger or anything. But maybe strength is just expected of us orcs.
m920088.へぇ、中々見込みのありそうな新人じゃない。\nそれじゃ、まずは走り込みよ。\n私: Huh, looks like a promising newcomer. Then let's start with a run. Can you keep up with me?
m920088.またいつでも挑戦してきな、\n最優先で受けて立ってやるよ。\n……まぁ勝つのはあ: Come challenge me anytime, I'll take you on first priority. …Well, I'll be the one winning, of course.
m920088.またベストラがアナトリアに挑戦してるのか。\nこりゃ面白そうだ。\nちょっと見て: Bestla's challenging Anatolia again, huh? This looks fun. I think I'll stick around and watch.
m920088.まだです、呼吸を乱さないでください！\nそのまま身体の力を維持しつつ、全身に酸素: Not yet, keep your breathing steady! While maintaining your body's strength, send oxygen through your whole body—breathe slowly…!!
m920088.まだまだだよ！ ベストラの力は\nそんなもんじゃないはずだよ！\n: Come on, you can do better than that! That's not the kind of power you have!
m920088.もちろんです、アナトリア。\n今度こそ、絶対に\nあなたに勝ってみせます！: Of course, Anatolia. This time, I'll definitely defeat you!
m920088.やはり、怒りの力を引き出せない事にはオークで\n一番になることなど夢のまた夢。\:
Indeed, without being able to tap into the power of anger, becoming the strongest orc is just a pipe dream.
…So I thought of something.
m920088.れ、冷静で良い奴……オーク族としては\n素直には喜べない評価です……。\n怒りを: Calm... a good guy? That's not exactly a compliment among orcs... I want to turn anger into strength...
m920088.アナトリアに挑戦なんて無理だと\nオークの皆には言われます……ですが、\n私は諦:
The other orcs say challenging Anatolia is impossible… but I won't give up!
I want to defeat that person!
m920088.オークとは何度も戦ってるしなぁ。\n軍にオークがいたとなると、\n警戒する奴もい: We've fought orcs countless times. If there's an orc in the ranks, some folks might get nervous.
m920088.ベストラさん、何やら吹っ切れた様子ですね。\n悩みが解決できたようで何よりです。: Bestla, you seem to have finally let go of whatever was weighing you down. I'm glad you were able to resolve your troubles. I'm sure you'll continue to be a reliable source of strength for us.
m920088.ベストラさん、限界だったのでしょう。\n……ですが最後の気迫、凄まじいものでした:
Bestla, you must have hit your limit.
...but your final resolve was truly awe-inspiring.
I could feel the sheer intensity of your fighting spirit.
m920088.ベストラと言います。此度は格闘家の皆さんで\n合同訓練をやると聞き、私も参加させ:
My name is Bestla. I heard there'd be a joint training with the fighters, so I thought I'd join as well.
I look forward to working with you.
m920088.一体何が足りないのでしょう……。: What on earth am I missing...?
m920088.下半身に一層パワーが集まるのを感じます！\n……あの、リンさん。もしよろしければ:
I can feel even more power gathering in my lower body!
…Um, Rin-san. If it's alright, I'd like to keep joining the morning drills from now on.
m920088.久々に良い戦いが出来て楽しかった。\nあんたは強い、胸を張んな。: It's been a while since a good fight—had fun. You're strong, hold your head high.
m920088.人間は、様々な感情を持ち合わせると聞いています。\n感情が豊かなあなた達人間の下:
I've heard humans possess a wide range of emotions.
If I train under you humans, who have such rich feelings,
perhaps I can draw out the power of anger!
m920088.以前の修行の時、一度だけ\n力を発揮できた事もあるんだが……\n……それ以降さっ: During the previous training, I managed to unleash my power once… but after that, nothing.
m920088.何より危険だよ。いつか、\nほんとに死んじゃうかもしれないし。: That's the most dangerous part. One day you might actually die.
m920088.俺も男だしな。女、子供に\n負ける訳にはいかねぇ……\n……いかねぇんだよ！:
I'm a man, after all. I can't afford to lose to women or kids…
…I really can't!
m920088.入門を許可して頂いたこと感謝致します。\n王子軍の下で\nしっかり鍛錬を積ませて: Thank you for granting me admission. I'll train hard under the Prince's army!
m920088.全く、うちの軍の兵士はいつから\nそんな軟弱者になったのかしら。: Seriously, when did our soldiers become so soft?
m920088.全身にビリビリと感じるこの闘志……オークの\n怒りの力に間違いなさそうだぜ！ \: I can feel this buzzing fighting spirit all over my body… It's definitely the Orcs' rage power! You've got it under control!
m920088.凄い。力が湧いてくるようだ。\nこれなら……あのアナトリアにも……！\nはぁあぁ: Amazing. I can feel power surging. With this... maybe I can even reach Anatolia... Haaah!!!
m920088.前回の魔界武術大会で優勝した方々の腕を、\nぜひ一度この目で見ておきたかったもの: I wanted to see the champions of the last Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament with my own eyes. As the rumors said, they were spectacular.
m920088.厳しい修行だと、はじめに言ったはずです！: I told you it'd be a harsh training from the start!
m920088.周りから馬鹿にされ、悔しい思いをしました。\n……ですが、\nだからこそ誰よりも:
I've been mocked and felt bitter.
…But because of that,
I've worked harder than anyone.
m920088.失礼しました。私はベストラ。\nオーク族で格闘家をやっています。: My apologies. I'm Bestla, an orc martial artist.
m920088.実はベストラ、オークの怒りの力ってのが\nコントロールできなくて困ってるみたい。:
Actually, Bestla seems to be having trouble controlling the ork's anger power.
Alice, do you maybe know a good way to handle it?
m920088.少しでも気を抜くと、あっという間に\n命が奪われる……ギリギリの命のやりとりは、: If you let your guard down even a bit, you'll lose your life in an instant... Those close-call battles toughen the heart!
m920088.少しはやるようになったみたいだね。\nでもまだまだだよ、その程度じゃ\nあたしは: Looks like you've improved a bit. But that's not enough—you can't show me your true power at that level!
m920088.怒りの力の訓練かぁ……うーんそんなの\nやったことないもんなぁ……そうだ、ひとま: Training with the power of anger, huh… hmm, I've never done something like that before… Hey, why don't you just join our training for now?
m920088.懲りないねぇ。何度戦っても、\nあんたじゃあたしには勝てないよ。\nそれでもやる: You never learn, do you? No matter how many times we fight, you'll never beat me. Still want to try?
m920088.折角面白そうな相手もいることだ、\nオークの戦い方の手本、見ておくといい。: Since we have some interesting opponents, you should watch how the orcs fight as a model.
m920088.普段と違う環境での特訓はやはり身が入りますね。\n皆さんとの力比べの成果でしょう: Training in a different setting really gets you into it. It must be the result of our power showdown… I feel like I've become even stronger.
m920088.最後までついてくるなんて……やるじゃない。\nここまでついてこれたのなんて、\n: Keeping up until the end… impressive. You're the first to make it this far.
m920088.望むところです！\n是非……是非お願いします！:
That's exactly what I'm hoping for!
Please… please, I'd be grateful!
m920088.望むところです！\n（闘志……私に足りないものは\nそれなのかも……！）: That's what I want! (Fighting spirit... maybe that's what's been missing in me...!)
m920088.本日は接近戦の訓練でしたね。\n戦いの基本は歩兵による接近戦、\n歩兵の強さは軍: Today was close-combat training. The basics of battle are infantry melee, and the strength of the infantry directly reflects the strength of the army.
m920088.歩兵の強さ……つまり力比べですね。\n力でしたら、少々自信があります！: Infantry strength… so basically a test of power. When it comes to power, I'm fairly confident!
m920088.毎度毎度、あんなに体を痛めつけないと\n力が発揮できないのは辛いよなぁ……。: It's rough having to hurt yourself every single time just to unleash your strength…
m920088.毎日続けないと、体が鈍っちゃうからね！\n日々の鍛錬は基本中の基本よ！！: If you don't keep training daily, your body gets sluggish. Daily drills are the foundation of everything!!
m920088.気を失われてしまったみたいですし、\nこのままにしておく訳にも参りません。\n一:
It looks like you've lost consciousness, and we can't just leave you like this.
Shall we move you to a cooler spot?
m920088.流石リンさん！ \n毎日精が出ますね！: As expected, Rin-san! You're always full of spirit every day!
m920088.無理を言ってすみません。格闘家の皆さんが\n過酷な修行を行っていると聞き、\nど: Sorry for the trouble. I heard the fighters endure harsh drills, and I just had to see for myself...
m920088.王子、アンナさん！\nこのままじゃベストラ死んじゃうよ！: Prince, Anna! If we keep going like this, Bestla's going to die!
m920088.王子、此度は近接兵の訓練となります。\nご采配を下すのは、近接兵のみにお願いしま: Prince, this time's training is for melee troops. Please issue your orders only to the melee units.
m920088.王子も皆さんの特訓に付き合って\nさぞお疲れのことでしょう。ゆっくりと\n休まれ: Prince, you must be exhausted after all that training with everyone. Please take some time to rest. Good work.
m920088.珍しいですね。\nリンさんの朝練は軍内でも有名な地獄の特訓、\n率先してやりたが: That's unusual. Rin-san's morning drills are infamous hellish training in the army, and yet nobody ever volunteers…
m920088.皆さん……本当にありがとうございます！ \nこの力ならきっと、\nアナトリアにも: Everyone… thank you so much! With this power, I'm sure it'll reach Anatolia too!
m920088.皆やる気充分ね！ よーっし！\n誰が一番力が強いか力比べと行きましょ！\n王子、: Everyone's fired up! Alright! Let's see who's the strongest—let's have a power showdown! Prince, here we go~!
m920088.目指すは打倒アナトリア！ \nよろしくお願いしますっ！！:
My goal is to take down Anatolia!
Please, count on me!!
m920088.私もです！ いつもこの鉛槍で鍛えてますから！: Same here! I've been honing my skills with this lead spear all the time!
m920088.私達に出来る事は彼女の勝利を信じ、\n見守る事のみですね。: All we can do is believe in her victory and watch over her.
m920088.私達オーク族にとって戦いこそ全て。\n強者に対しては戦いを挑むことで\n尊敬の意:
For us orcs, battle is everything.
Challenging a stronger opponent is how we show respect—it's our custom.
m920088.穏やかな心を持ったまま怒りの力に\n目覚めたオークの戦士……うん、\nわたしはこ: An Orc warrior who awakens to rage power while keeping a gentle heart… Yeah, that's more like Bestla!
m920088.良い訓練になったようで何よりね。……にしても、\nオークって荒々しかったり無骨な: Glad it was good training. …I always thought orcs were rough and clumsy, but there are gentle ones like you, Bestla.
m920088.良かった。皆さん今日もここで\n修行されてたのですね。: Good. Everyone's training here again today, huh.
m920088.見守るだけでも一苦労ですね。\n王子、戦闘のご準備を！: Even just watching is a hassle. Prince, prepare for battle!
m920088.負けず嫌いも程々にしな、\nそれ以上やったらほんとに死んじまうよ。\nあんた達、: Don't be so stubborn. Push it any further and you'll actually die. You all, get ready to carry her away!
m920088.身体の動きを支える下半身、その強さは\n戦闘じゃ最も重要と言っても過言じゃないわ: The lower body that supports your movements—its strength is arguably the most crucial thing in combat! Train it well!!
m920088.辛い朝練……！？ \nその朝練、是非私も\n参加させては貰えませんか！: A tough morning drill…? I'd love to join that drill, if I may.
m920088.辛い特訓を乗り越えてこそ、\n強くなった実感が得られるものですから！: Only by overcoming harsh training can you truly feel you've become stronger!
m920088.追い詰められてからの底力……\nオークの本領発揮って所ね！: The hidden strength that shows up when you're cornered... that's the ork's true power!
m920088.頑張って、ベストラ！ \nベストラなら絶対勝てるよ！: Do your best, Bestla! You'll definitely win!
m920088.魔界の噂ですか……王子は\n魔界でもすっかり有名人なのですね。: Rumors from the Demon Realm… Prince, you're quite famous even there.
m920088.魔界武術大会で出会ったドゥーラさんは\n良い人でしたよ。オークさんだからって\n: The Doola we met at the Demon Realm Tournament was a good person. Being an orc shouldn't be a reason to turn you down!
m920088.（……！ 呼吸を……乱さないように……）: (…! I must keep my breathing… steady…)
m920088.（い……意識が……しかしここで意識を\n手放す訳には……私は……強く……\n……: (I… I can feel my consciousness… but I can't just let it go now… I have to… become stronger… I must become stronger…!!)

m920112.――そこまで！\nひとまずこちらの訓練は終了と致します。\n皆さん、お疲れ様でし: —That's enough! We'll call this training session over for now. Everyone, good work.
m920112.――来ましたっ！\n王子、ご指示をお願いします！: —Here they come! Prince, give the orders!
m920112.――話は聞かせてもらった。俺も参加させてもらおう。: —I've heard the story. Let me join in too.
m920112.…………承知いたしました。\nでは、その方向で進めさせて頂きます。: ………Understood. I'll move forward with that plan.
m920112.……あ、あれ？ さっきまで後ろにいた兵士は……？: …Huh? The soldier who was behind us a moment ago…?
m920112.……いえ、キャリーさん。\nもし宜しければ、今回の訓練では\nこのまま奇襲役を務: No, Carrie. If you're willing, could you take on the role of a surprise attacker for this exercise?
m920112.……いえ。\n今のは本当に誰も予想していなかった事態です……。: …No. What just happened was truly unexpected…
m920112.……おや、なにか面白そうなことが始まるようですね。\nフーリさん、私たちも行くで: …Oh, looks like something interesting is about to start. Khuri, shall we go as well?
m920112.……けど、私はそれなりに楽しかったわ。\nそれに、おかげさまで王子やみんなと一緒: …But I actually had fun. And thanks to that, I got to watch this beautiful sunset with the Prince and everyone else♪
m920112.……しかし、確かにここ最近の暑さはたまりませんな。\nこの様子だとあと数日は続く: …Indeed, this recent heat is relentless. It looks like it'll last a few more days.
m920112.……そろそろキャリーさんたちが\n再びここを通る頃ですね。: …Looks like Carrie and the others will be passing through here again soon.
m920112.……でも、王子に気に入って頂けたなら嬉しいです。\n機会があったら、また一緒に海:
...But I'm glad Prince liked it.
If we get the chance, let's go to the beach together again, okay?
m920112.……ねえ王子、キャリー見てない？\nさっきからずっと探してるんだけど……。: …Hey Prince, have you seen Carrie? I've been looking for her since earlier…
m920112.……はっ！ ち、違いますッ！\nこのモミジ、決して久しぶりに海に来たことが\n嬉: …Ha! N-no, that's not it! This Momiji isn't just thrilled about finally coming to the sea…!
