m920112.皆さん、海ですよ海っ！\n青い空、白い砂浜……あ、カニさん発見ですっ！: Everyone, it's the sea! The blue sky, the white sand… Ah, I've spotted a crab!
m920112.相手は機動力の高い騎兵の方々です。\n速さに任せて突破されないよう、\n確実に足: Our opponents are highly mobile cavalry. We need to hold them down and suppress them so they can't break through on speed.
m920112.私、王子や他のみんなと一緒に\n海で遊びたいって、ずっと思ってまして……。\nだ:
I've always wanted to have fun at the beach with you, Prince, and everyone else...
So today turned out to be a wonderful memory.
m920112.私も楽しかったわ。\nこれもキャリーさんが水着を着てきてくれたおかげね。: I had fun too. That's thanks to you showing up in a swimsuit.
m920112.笑止。これは忍びの正装です。: Nonsense. This is formal ninja attire.
m920112.訓練中のどこかのタイミングで\nキャリーが急に襲ってくるってワケね。\n……ふふ: So during the training, you'll suddenly launch an attack, huh? …Hehe, sounds like fun!
m920112.訓練時は暑さのピークを避けてはいるのですが、\nそれでも結局、兵が心身ともに\n: We try to avoid the peak heat during training, but the fact remains that the soldiers are ending up exhausted, both mentally and physically.
m920112.負けませんよぉーっ！\n弓兵部隊の皆さんも行きましょう！: I won't lose!! Archers, let's go!
m920112.騎兵部隊、出撃！\n我らの神速を篤とお見せしようじゃないか！: Cavalry, deploy! Let's demonstrate our lightning speed!
m920112.（……よし、そろそろ奇襲しよう――）: (…Alright, time to launch a surprise attack—)
m920112.（た、確かにその通りかも……！）\n……わかりました。王子や皆さんのためでしたら: (That's… actually true…!) …Alright. If it's for the Prince and everyone else, I'll strip down—one layer, two layers, whatever it takes!
m920112.（モーティマ、背中……。\n釣り竿、見えてる……説得力……ない……）: (Mortimer… his back… the fishing rod is visible… no convincing… )
m920112.（海、かぁ……。\n確かに最近、ずっと訓練ばっかりだったし……）: (The sea, huh… It's true we've been training nonstop lately…)
m920112.（私も一日くらい、王子たちと一緒に\n海で思いっきり遊んでみたいなぁ……）: (I'd love to spend a day at the beach, just playing with the Prince and the others…)

m920125.――しかし心を操られ、わらわのもとへ来たとなれば、\nおそらく邪仙の手による計略: —But if her heart was manipulated and she came to me, it must have been Jasen's scheme.
m920125.…………うぅ、さすがはわらわの惚れた男よ。\n恩に着るぞ、王子よ。\nなればさっ: ………Ah, just as I expected of the man I adore. I owe you, Prince. Then let's go find the Queen at once!
m920125.…………くっ、そんな笑顔で頷いても、\n私はお姉さまみたいにちょろく懐いたりしま: …*cough* Even if you smile and nod, I won't fall for you like my sister did.
m920125.……あの、えぇと……くっ。\nやっぱり、私が人間なんかにお礼なんて……。: …Um… uh… *cough*… I still can't bring myself to thank a human…
m920125.……こほん。\n人間の王子、あなたを襲ってしまったこと、\nここに深くお詫びしま: *ahem* Prince, for having attacked you, I sincerely apologize.
m920125.……何を言っているのか分からない、\nそんなまぬけ顔に見えますわね。\nだから、: …I can't make sense of what you're saying; you look so clueless. That's why… *ugh*…
m920125.あやつも、かつての持ち主と同じく、\n音楽で人々を癒そうとしたのじゃろうな。\n: She probably, like her former owner, tried to heal people with music. But the situation was just too dire.
m920125.けれど、琵琶の音に負の感情を乗せる術、\nあれはもう使えそうにありませんの……。: But the technique of loading negative emotions onto the biwa's sound… I don't think I can use that anymore.
m920125.さっきは「邪悪なる王子と人間共」などと、\nわらわの妹分が暴言を吐いて、\n本当: Earlier, my little sister let loose insults like “the evil prince and humans,” and I'm truly sorry for that, Prince.
m920125.しかし不承不承邪仙に従っておったわらわと違って、\n王妃人は、そも人というものを: But unlike me, who reluctantly obeyed Jasen, the Queen actually despised humans. It's understandable, given how she was born…
m920125.それからそんな私を助けてくれたこと、\n改めてもう一度、お礼を言わせてくださいな: And for rescuing me, let me thank you properly once more.
m920125.ですから、順を追って、ちょっとずつ、\nあなたが悪人でないことを確かめてから、\: So I'll take it step by step, confirming you're not a villain before I let my guard down.
m920125.では王子、これからよろしくお願いしますわ。\n……あっ、お部屋はお姉さまの隣にし: Then, Prince, I look forward to working with you from now on. …Ah, and please keep your room next to my sister's, okay?
m920125.でも助けてもらったのも、\nお姉さまがお世話になっているのも事実。\nこうなれば: Still, it's true you saved me, and my sister is indebted to you. At this point, I have no choice but to steel myself.
m920125.ほれ、厄介者と親しいとなれば、\nあやつも邪仙郷で生きてゆけぬじゃろう？\nゆえ: You see, if you get close to a troublemaker, she couldn't survive in Jasenkyō. So it had to be a secret relationship.
m920125.まぁそういう条件で良ければ、\n手を貸してあげないこともないですわ。\n――いか: Well, if those terms suit you, I wouldn't refuse to lend a hand. —What do you think?
m920125.もう二度と会うこともないじゃろうと\n覚悟は決めておったが、こうなっては見過ごせ: I was prepared to never see her again, but I can't just turn a blind eye now. Prince, will you help the Queen?
m920125.仲間に加わってやっても良いと言っているのですわ！\nもう、人間はこれだから……っ: I'm saying you may join our ranks! Humans are just…!
m920125.元々あれは、皇天君の仙術に影響されたもの。\nですからあの時の力は期待しないでく: It was originally influenced by the Celestial Emperor's sorcery, so don't expect that power now.
m920125.妖怪が現れた、音楽で俺達を惑わす気だと、\n怯えた街の者達に石を投げられたそうじ: People thought the yokai would confuse us with music, and they threw stones at her in terror…
m920125.幸か不幸か、わらわも妖怪じゃったからの。\nあやつと打ち解けるのは実に早かった。: Whether fortunate or not, I was also a yokai, so we bonded quickly. It couldn't be made public, but those were happy days.
m920125.操られていたから仕方ない……？\n……いいや、あれは王妃人の本音でもあろう。: She was being manipulated, so there was nothing she could do…? …No, that was probably the Queen's true feelings.
m920125.無理やり従わされておったわらわと違って、\nあやつは実力を認められて邪仙郷に入っ: Unlike me, who was forced to obey, she earned her place in Jasenkyō by her own strength. I tried hard to keep it hidden from others…
m920125.王妃人とわらわが出会ったのは、邪仙郷にて、\nわらわが無理やり協力させられておっ: I first met the Queen back in Jasenkyō, when I was being forced to cooperate. Heh, she too was rescued by Jasen.
m920125.王妃人は、長く楽師に愛され、\n年月を経た琵琶より生まれた、\n付喪神なる妖怪じ: The Queen was a tsukumogami—a spirit born from a biwa that had been cherished by musicians for ages.
m920125.街の連中にも悪気は無かったとは思うがの。\nそれでも、王妃人は深く心を傷つけられ: I don't think the townsfolk meant any harm. Still, the Queen was deeply wounded, and while she was wandering, Jasen discovered her power.
m920125.魔物が復活し、誰も彼もが明日をも知れぬ世を、\nうつむき、怯えて歩いていた頃じゃ: Monsters revived, and everyone was living in fear, not knowing what tomorrow would bring. In that town, when a yokai like her appeared…

m920199.――戦神コロッセウムの時間だぁぁぁぁぁ！！: ――It's time for the War God Colosseummmmm!!
m920199.………お客さん、ちょっといいですか？: ……Excuse me, customer? Can I have a word?
m920199.……「麗しき銀銃」か。\nこいつはこの町に滞在してるガンスリンガーだよ。:
……The "Silver Gun," huh.
She's a gunslinger staying in this town.
m920199.……あ？\nもしやそこにおわすのは、\n王子様と王国軍かァ？:
……Huh?
Could it be that you sitting over there are
the Prince and the Royal Army?
m920199.……えっ、壊したお店の賠償金？\nこんな額払えませんよーー！？:
……Huh? Compensation for the damage I caused?
I can't possibly afford that much—!?
m920199.……この幻影、たぶん一方通行だな。\nこっちの声は聞こえてないみたいだぞ。:
...This phantom is probably one-way.
It doesn't seem to be hearing us.
m920199.……そうか。アンタたちは、\nこの町のことを知らないのか。:
……I see. You guys don't know
about this town, do you.
m920199.……丁度良かったかもしれないな。\n現在残っている戦士団は、王国の王子と、\n今:
……That might have worked out for the best.
The only warriors left are the Kingdom's Prince and
the mine outlaws you just mentioned.
m920199.……待てよ。\nこれが前の時と同じなら、\n開始の日程は――:
...Wait.
If it's the same as last time,
the start date is――
m920199.……待てよ？\n王国の人たちなら、\nもしかしたら……。:
……Wait a second.
If you're from the Kingdom,
maybe you could…
m920199.……決闘でしょうか。\n黒衣の銃士と、保安官らしき人物が対峙していますね。:
……A duel, is it.
The Black-Clothed Gunslinger and a figure resembling the Sheriff are facing off.
m920199.あ、あの二人のゴブリンは……！？\nもしかして、ゴブリンブラザーズですか……！？:
Oh, those two goblins over there……!
Could they be the Goblin Brothers……!?
m920199.ああ――そこまで！\n優勝者は、王国の王子！！:
Aye—stop right there!
The winner is… the Prince of the Kingdom!!
m920199.ああ、そうさ。アタシはトネール。\nこの町に滞在する賞金稼ぎだよ。:
Yeah, I am. I'm Tonnerre.
I'm a bounty hunter staying in this town.
m920199.ああ。この町で一番狂暴なオンナさ。: I do. She's the most violent woman in this town.
m920199.ああ。それに無法者の中には\n戦神コロッセウムの参加者もいるはずだ。:
Indeed. Besides, some of those outlaws
are likely participating in the War God Colosseum.
m920199.ああ。アンタたちなら信頼できる。\nそれに、ちゃんとした人が管理してないと、\n:
Aye. I trust you lot.
Besides, if it's not managed by the right people, this town is far too dangerous.
m920199.ああ。戦神コロッセウムの参加者だとかいう、\n無法者の集まりだよ。:
Ah, yes. They're a bunch of outlaws
who claim to be participants in the War God Colosseum.
m920199.ああ。選手同士で戦い合い、\n勝ち残った２チームが決勝戦への出場権を手にする。\:
Yes. The fighters battle each other,
and the two teams that survive earn a spot in the finals.
Same rules as last time.
m920199.あっ、吟遊詩人さんが、賑やかな音楽を、\n演奏してくれています……！: Oh, the bard is playing some lively music……!
m920199.あなたは、戦神コロッセウムの参加者でしょうか？: Are you a participant in the War God Colosseum?
m920199.あの……しれっと会話に入ってきた\nそこの女性はどなたでしょうか？:
U-um… who is that lady who just
jumped right into our conversation?
m920199.あの……無理して盛り上げようとしなくても……。: Um... you don't have to try so hard to hype things up...
m920199.あれは、戦神コロッセウムの参加チームかしら？: Are those a team participating in the War God Colosseum?
m920199.い、いきなり幻影が……。\nあっ、戦神マレスでしたか。:
S-suddenly, a phantom...
Oh, it was War God Mares.
m920199.いえ、お気になさらず。\n私たちも屋内で落ち着いて話を聞きたかったので。:
Please, don't worry about it.
We wanted to sit down indoors and listen in peace, too.
m920199.いったいどうやったのかは気になるが……\nその噂は確かみたいだねぇ。:
I'm curious how she pulled that off, but…
It seems that rumor is true.
m920199.いや、そんなことしないよ……？: No, we're not going to do anything like that…?
m920199.うぅ、すいませんマレス様……。\n急だったので上手く反応できず……。:
I'm sorry, Mares-sama...
It came out of nowhere, so I couldn't react properly...
m920199.うふふっ、お見事……。\nお手合わせ、ありがとうございました。\nとても楽しいひ:
Mm, well done…
Thank you for the match.
It was a very enjoyable time.
m920199.うむ、うむ、うむッ！\n貴様らも早く戦いたくて仕方がないことだろう！:
Mm, mm, mm!
You're all dying to fight, aren't you!
m920199.え、えぇっ……！？\nま、まさか、あのゴブリンは……！:
E-Excuse me…!?
C-Could it be that those goblins are…!
m920199.ええ、そうですよ。\nとはいえここで襲いかかるのは、\n我ながら空気が読めていな:
Yes, that is correct.
Though attacking you here seems a bit
out of touch with the atmosphere, don't you think?
m920199.ええ、まったくです。\nここの人たちは毎日毎日、\n無軌道な行動を繰り返していま:
????: Oh, indeed it is.
The people here engage in reckless behavior
day after day…
m920199.ええと……それで、トネールさんは先程、\nこの町を救ってほしいと言いましたが、\:
Um… so, Tonnerre, you just asked us to save this town.
Could you explain what you mean by that?
m920199.えっ、は、はい。\nそうですが――:
E-Excuse me, yes.
We are, but—
m920199.おいおいマジか！\n強者と名高き王子様とこんな辺鄙な町で会えるとは！\n感謝申し:
No way, seriously!
To meet the renowned Prince, a true powerhouse, in a backwater town like this!
Thank you, War Goddess Maless!
m920199.おっと、そいつは驚いた。\nこの町に、こんな慈悲深いヤツらがいるとはね。:
Oh, well I'll be.
So there are people in this town with a heart of gold.
m920199.おっ！ はりきった連中がいるな！\nちょっとばかし可愛がってやるか！:
??? : Oh ho! Some eager ones, huh!
Let's show them some mercy!
m920199.お酒を奢りたくなったときでも、\n戻ってきていいですからね？:
Even if you just get the urge to buy me a drink,
you're welcome to come back!
m920199.かの王子様、そして王国軍と戦えるたァ光栄極まれり！\n勝手に胸を借りさせていただ:
To fight the Prince and the Royal Army! What an honor!
Please, let us borrow your strength!
m920199.き、気をつけてください！\n彼女の演奏は仲間たちを……\n無法者たちの攻撃力を、:
P-Please be careful!
Her music has the effect of greatly boosting the attack power of her allies…
the outlaws!
m920199.きゃっ！？ さ、酒瓶が飛んできました！？: Kyaa! A, a bottle just flew by!
m920199.くすっ。人気者ね、王子。\n彼女ったらあんなに目を輝かせて……。\n標的を貴方に:
Heh. You're quite popular, Prince.
Look at her eyes lighting up like that…
She's switched her target to you.
m920199.くっ、これで終わり……！？\nいや、まだだ！ まだ終わってねェ……ッ！\nもっと:
Curses… is this the end…!?
No, not yet! It's not over yet…!
I want to keep fighting…!!
m920199.くっ、返り討ちに遭うとはねぇ……！: Tch, to be beaten by a bunch of rookies…!
m920199.けれど、それだけじゃありませんわ。\n文句は言いたそうですけど、彼女の奏でる音は:
But it's not just that.
She seems to have her complaints, but the music she plays
also sounds like a celebration of our victory.
m920199.ここが鉱山か。\nアタシも足を踏み入れるのははじめてだねぇ。:
So this is the mine.
It's the first time I've ever set foot in one.
m920199.ここに戻ることはなさそうだねぇ。: It doesn't look like we'll be coming back here anytime soon.
m920199.ここは、鋼の都の西の土地さ。: This is the land west of the Steel Capital.
m920199.これで、この町の無法者たちは、\n全員退治できたのでしょうか。: Does this mean we've dealt with all the outlaws in this town?
m920199.これはご丁寧に……。\nご、ごちそうになります……！:
Oh, that's very kind of you…
I-I'll gladly accept your generosity…!
m920199.さてと。王子様と戦えていい気分だし、酒飲んで寝て……\nあっ。鉱山の連中、どうす:
Well. I feel great after fighting the Prince. Time for a drink and a nap…
Ah. What about the guys at the mine…?
m920199.しけた決闘なんざ中止だ中止！\n保安官殿も王子様と戦いたいと仰ってるしなァ！:
I'm calling off this boring duel!
The Marshal wants to fight the Prince too, so—
m920199.すごくいい戦いだったので、\nここの会計は私が持ちますね。: It was such a wonderful match, so I'll be covering the bill here.
m920199.そいつはありがたい。\nまぁ落ち着いてるとは言い難い雰囲気だけどね……。:
That's a relief.
Though "peace" might be a stretch in this atmosphere…
m920199.そういうことでしたら、\n見過ごすわけにはいきません。:
If that's the case, we can't just
look the other way.
m920199.そういうわけで、\nアンタたちにはこの町の連中をとっちめてほしいのさ。\nじゃな:
So, I'm asking you lot to put those ruffians in their place.
Otherwise, they'll just keep causing trouble forever.
m920199.そうさ！ この無法者の町を、\n――アンタたちに、救ってほしいんだ！:
That's right! I want you to save
this town of outlaws!
m920199.そうだったのかい！\nだったらそこにいるのは王国の王子サマか！\nこいつは無礼を:
I see!
Then the one standing there must be the Prince of the Kingdom!
I really shouldn't have been so rude…
m920199.そうだな。これで一件落着！\n……なんだけどさ。:
I suppose so. That's one case closed!
…But, you know.
m920199.そうですね……。\n暴れたせいで店主がカンカンなので、\nとりあえず酒場の修理で:
Well, I suppose…
Since I caused quite a ruckus, the Shopkeeper is furious,
so I might as well help with the repairs for now.
m920199.そうなると、この町は今日から、\n「王子タウン」となるわけですね。:
In that case, this town will become
“Prince Town” starting today.
m920199.そのためにトネールさんの力も、\n貸してもらっていいでしょうか？: May we have Tonnerre's help with that as well?
m920199.そのまんまの意味さ。\nこの酒場を見ただけでも分かると思うが、\nここは無法者だ:
It's exactly as it sounds.
Just look around this tavern and you'll see.
It's a complete mess, overrun with outlaws.
m920199.その少女は、ギター一本で、\n無法者をまとめ上げた、吟遊詩人なのだそうです……。:
Apparently, she's a bard who unified the outlaws
with nothing but a single guitar…
m920199.それから、貴方たちを応援することにします。\n頑張ってくださいね。:
After that, I've decided to cheer you on.
Please do your best.
m920199.それで、アンタはこれからどうするつもりだい？: So, what are your plans for now?
m920199.それで、吟遊詩人のゴブリンさんは……\nギ、ギターで不服そうな音を鳴らしています:
So, what about the goblin bard…
She's strumming her guitar, sounding rather displeased…
m920199.それでお相手の無法者は……\nおっと、あれかい？:
And our opponents, the outlaws…
Oh, is that them?
m920199.それはできると思いますけど、いいんですか？: I think that's something you can do, but… is it alright?
m920199.それはまぁ……町の人々の有様を思うと、\n不安はありますね。:
Well… looking at the state of the townsfolk,
I can see why you'd be worried.
m920199.だが保安官殿がそう仰るなら仕方がねェ。\n尊き御仁たちの時間をいただきすぎるのも:
But if the Marshal says so, I suppose I have no choice.
I wouldn't want to waste too much of your precious time, either.
So I'll put my gun away and behave myself.
m920199.だけど、保安官殿はもう終わりって言ってるわよ？: But the Marshal says it's over, you know?
m920199.ついでに戦士としても一流とお見受けするよ。: I'd say she's a first-rate warrior, too.
m920199.で、いい加減邪魔なんで、\nアタシか保安官殿の勝ったほうが連中に挑む、\nってこ:
They're getting in the way, so
we agreed that whoever wins the duel would challenge them.
That's why we were about to start.
m920199.で、お前らはなんだァ？\nアタシらは取り込み中……。:
And what are you lot?
We're in the middle of a job…
m920199.で、アタシをどうするってんだ？\n鉱山に送り込んで死ぬまで働かせるかい？:
So, what are you going to do with me?
Send me to the mines to work until I die?
m920199.どうやらそのようです！\n王子、迅速な指揮をお願いします！:
It seems so!
Prince, I'll leave the command to you!
m920199.どこのどいつかは知らないが、\nこの町に来ちまったのが運の尽き！\n大人しく倒さ:
??? : I don't know who you are or where you're from,
but coming to this town was your last mistake!
Lay down and die, will ya!
m920199.な、なんか、酒場の人たちも、\n騒ぎに便乗して襲ってきませんでしたか！？:
T-Those tavern patrons were trying to
jump in on the fight, weren't they?!
m920199.なぁ、王子サマ。\nよかったら、この町を王国の庇護下にいれてくれないか？:
Hey, Your Highness.
If you don't mind, would you place this town under the Kingdom's protection?
m920199.なぁ！ アンタたちの強さを見込んで、\nひとつ頼みがある！:
Hey! I've been watching your strength,
so I have a favor to ask!
m920199.なっ、いきなり銃を抜いて……！？\nまさか貴殿は戦神コロッセウムの参加者か！？:
W-what?! Drawing your gun so suddenly…!
Could it be that you're a participant in the War God Colosseum?!
m920199.なら、行くとしようかね。\n――決勝戦へ。:
Then let's go.
—To the final match.
m920199.にしてもアンタたちはえらく強いねぇ。\n一体、何者なんだい？:
Anyway, you guys are seriously strong.
Who exactly are you?
m920199.は、はい……噂で聞いたことが、あります……。\n私と似たような……人間に近い容姿:
Y-Yes… I've heard rumors…
About a goblin girl who looks very much like me…
Someone with a human-like appearance…
m920199.び、びっくりしました……。\nここは……荒野の開拓地でしょうか？:
That was a surprise...
Is this... the Frontier Wasteland?
m920199.ふむ、皆様はこれから町を救うそうですが――\nそれは私に勝てたらのお話ですね？:
Hmm, so you intend to save this town—
but only if you can defeat me, correct?
m920199.もちろんさ！ 頼むだけ頼んで、\n自分はなにもしないなんてのは、\nオンナが廃る:
Of course! Asking for help and then
just standing by and doing nothing?
That's no way for a woman to act!
m920199.やりました。宴の始まりですね！\n王子様の優勝と町の新たな門出を祝って、\n今日:
We did it! The feast begins!
To celebrate the Prince's victory and the town's new beginning,
let's all party it up tonight!
m920199.アイツは……「皆殺しの凶銃」か。: That one is… the Massacre Gun.
m920199.アイツら、満面の笑みで銃を抜いたねぇ。\n悪いけど王子サマ、相手してやってくれる:
They've already drawn their guns with those big grins.
I'm sorry, Your Highness, but could you please take them on?
m920199.アタシだよ。\nそれよりアンタたちはここで何をしてるんだい？:
It's me.
But more importantly, what are you all doing here?
m920199.ギャギャー！ チカラ、ミナギル！！\nアネゴ、オンガク！ パワー、スゴイ！！:
Gya-gya! Strength, feel it!!
Big sis, the music!
It's got so much power!!
m920199.ゴブリンブラザーズ！？\nなんだいソイツらは！:
The Goblin Brothers!?
Who are those guys?
m920199.ソイツらが鉱山を仕切ってるせいで、\n誰も採掘作業ができねェ。\nだからここの奴:
Because they control the mine,
no one else can do any mining work.
That's why the locals are so restless.
m920199.ハーッハッハッハッハァ！！\n嬉しいか戦士たちよ！\n貴様らの歓声が俺様には聞こ:
Hahahaha!!
Are you excited, warriors?
I can hear your cheers!!
m920199.バトルロイヤルで、そして皆様のような強者を前にして、\nお行儀よくしろというのは:
In a battle royale, facing warriors of your caliber,
expecting me to behave politely would be unreasonable.
Shall we have a duel?
m920199.一旦彼女たちを倒すしかなさそうですね。: It looks like we have no choice but to take them down first.
m920199.人類最強決定戦・開拓地の部。\nこれより決勝戦を――開始する！！:
The Strongest of Humanity Tournament, Frontier Division.
I hereby declare the final match—begin!!
m920199.今じゃすっかり、\n町は無法者で溢れちまったよ。:
Now, the town is completely
overrun with outlaws.
m920199.今回はどんな人たちと戦うことに――\nって、わぁ！？ 馬車が突っ込んできます！:
I wonder who we'll be fighting this time――
Oh! A carriage is coming at us!
m920199.何度貴殿らのところに乗り込んで仕合を願おうとしたか！\nまぁそんなことしたら牢屋:
How many times have I tried to storm your place to challenge you to a match!
Well, I couldn't actually do it, since I'd end up in a cell, but still!!
m920199.健闘を祈りますね！\n皆様、頑張ってくださいっ！:
Good luck!
Please, everyone, do your best!
m920199.優勝を祝いにきたに決まってんだろ。\nおらッ、浴びられるくらいの酒もってきたぞォ:
To celebrate your victory, obviously.
Here, I brought enough booze for you to drown in!
m920199.元は未開の地だったんだが、\n金や珍しい鉱石が取れるとかで、\n一攫千金を狙う無:
It was a wilderness at first, but
they say gold and rare ores can be mined here,
so outlaws flocked in, hoping to strike it rich.
m920199.先に行こう。\n参加者たちを倒す方が、建設的だから……。:
Let's move on.
Defeating the participants is the more productive option…
m920199.先程から町という言葉が出てきますが、\nいったいここはどのような場所なのですか？:
You keep saying "town," but
what kind of place is this, exactly?
m920199.勝手に鉱山に住み着いて、利益を独占してる……\nまぁ、この町の実質的な支配者みて:
They moved into the mine without permission and monopolized the profits…
They're basically the ones running this town.
m920199.双方、準備はいいみたいだな。\nでは僭越ながら、開始の宣言をさせてもらおう。:
It seems both sides are ready.
Then, with your permission, I shall make the declaration.
m920199.可愛い妹の危機に駆けつけてきたわけか！\n注意してかかったほうが良さそうだねぇ！: We'd better be careful when we engage them!
m920199.吟遊詩人のゴブリンさんの、義兄弟です……！\nなんでも、女だてらに腕が立つ彼女を: They rushed over to protect their precious little sister in danger!
m920199.大変な目に遭いましたね。\nおや？ あれは……。:
You've been through quite a lot, haven't you?
Oh my? What is that…
m920199.奏でる音色を聞くだけでわかりますわ。\n彼女は一流の演奏者ですわよ……！:
I can tell just by listening to the melody.
She is a first-rate musician…!
m920199.待たせたな戦士たち！\n俺様も待ちわびていたぞ！！:
I hope I didn't keep you waiting, warriors!
I've been waiting for this too!!
m920199.恐れ多いがダセェと言わざるを得ねェよ。\n保安官殿もその名前はないと仰ってるぜェ:
I can't help but say it's both an honor and a bit tacky.
Even the Marshal says he's against that name.
m920199.悪いね、酒場まで来てもらって。: Sorry to drag you all the way to the tavern.
m920199.我々は王国の者です。\n戦神コロッセウムの参加チームとして、\nここに転移させら:
We're from the Kingdom.
We were teleported here as a team
participating in the War God Colosseum.
m920199.戦神コロッセウム本戦！\n人類最強決定戦・開拓地の部ッ！！\nここにッ！ 開幕だ:
The War God Colosseum main event!
The Strongest of Humanity Decisive Battle, Frontier Division!!
Here it is! The curtain rises!!!
m920199.本当にすまないが……空間転移するぞ。: I'm sorry, but... I'm teleporting us.
m920199.本当に急に始まりますね……。\n今回も、前回と同じく、最後の２チームに\nなるま:
It really does start on a moment's notice...
Is it a battle royale again, where we fight until only two teams remain?
m920199.構わない、ってことか？\nははは！ 王国の王子サマは強いだけじゃなく、\n器まで:
You're saying it's no big deal?
Hahaha! So the Prince of the Kingdom
is not only strong, but has a big heart too!
m920199.此度の会場は荒野の開拓地！\n無法者が集う地で、存分に武を競うがいいッ！:
The venue for this event is the Frontier Wasteland!
A land where outlaws gather. Show me your true strength!
m920199.決勝戦の相手が決まった、ってことかい？: So the opponent for the final match is decided?
m920199.無法者の退治は町を救うだけでなく、\n優勝にも繋がるだろう。:
Dealing with the outlaws will not only save the town,
it could also lead to victory.
m920199.無法者の集団のようにも見えますが……。: They look like a gang of outlaws, though...
m920199.私のことはおいておきまして。\nトネールさんの言うとおりこの町は、\n住民たちの:
Please, don't mind me.
As Tonnerre said, this town is on the verge of ruin
because of its residents.
m920199.聞き分けがよくて助かりますね。\n……いえ、襲いかかってきたので、\n聞き分けが:
I'm glad you're so reasonable.
…No, that's not it. You attacked us,
so "reasonable" isn't quite the right word.
m920199.色々と大変な町だけど、\nこれからよろしく頼んだぜ。:
It's a rough town with a lot going on, but
I'm counting on you all from here on out.
m920199.見りゃあ分かるだろ？\n決闘だよ決闘。\n保安官殿となァ。:
Can't you tell just by looking?
It's a duel. A duel.
With the Sheriff, that is.
m920199.誰だァ。つけられた覚えのない\n物騒なあだ名でアタシを呼んだのは。:
Who the hell are you?
Calling me by that dangerous nickname I never asked for.
m920199.貴殿ら、鉱山の奴らをぶっ倒してくれんのかァ？\nだったらアタシからもお願い致すぜ:
Will you take down the mine outlaws?
If so, I'd like to ask a favor of you too!
The Marshal says the same!
m920199.酒と血と暴力に酔ってるからねぇ。\nこんなのばっかりだから、\nアンタたちに頼ん:
They're drunk on booze, blood, and violence.
That's why I'm relying on you guys, after all.
m920199.面白いねぇ！\nアタシも腕が鳴るってもんさ！:
How interesting!
Now I'm itching to show off my own skills!

m920216.……そういうことになりますね。\nすみません、ああいう人なんです。:
...I suppose that's how it is.
I apologize. That's just how she is.
m920216.……ふん、そこまで言うのなら仕方がない。\n引き受けた手前、逃げるのも性に合わん:
……Hmph, if you put it that way, I suppose I have no choice.
Since I've already agreed, running away isn't in my nature anyway.
m920216.……ぼくたちの気迫勝ち、かな？\nこれはしばらく飛べそうにないや。:
...I think our sheer willpower carried the day.
I don't think I can fly for a while.
m920216.……ウルカノくん、\n祝祭の成功は僕たちの手に懸かっている。\n共に最高のジュー:
……Vulcano,
the success of the festival rests in our hands.
Let's work together to make this the ultimate June Bride!
m920216.──そこまで！ 勝者、王国の王子！: That's enough! The winner is the Prince of the Kingdom!
m920216.──つまり娘々仮面の目的は、\n王子の花嫁さんになることじゃなくて、\n全力のあ:
So... the Masked Maidens' goal wasn't to become the Prince's bride?
It was to fight us at full power?
m920216.──よーし、まずはあたしの出番ね？\nデーモンなのに神殿前ってのが少し不満だけど:
──Alright, is it my turn first?
I'm a bit put off that a demon is performing in front of the temple, but
I can't afford to look unseemly in front of the lady!
m920216.──ウルカノくん！ この荷物はここで良かったかな？: ──Vulcano! Did I drop these things in the right spot?
m920216.──ッ！ 皆さん、出口の扉が開きません！: ──! Everyone, the exit doors won't open!
m920216.──フハハハハハハ！ よくぞ来た、王国の戦士たちよ！: ──Fuhahahahaha! Well done, warriors of the Kingdom!
m920216.──話は聞かせてもらったぞッ！\nその祭り、俺様が出資してやろう！:
──I've been listening to all of this!
I'll fund that festival myself!
m920216.『ぎたぁ』と合わせるのは初めてだったけど、\n悪くない『せっしょん』ができたんじ:
It was my first time harmonizing with a "guitar,"
but didn't we pull off a pretty good "section"?
m920216.あ、亜神マレスっ！？ どうしてここに！？: Ah, Demigod Mares!? What are you doing here!?
m920216.ああくそっ！ マレスの野郎もどっか行きやがった！: Damn it! That bastard Mares is gone too!
m920216.あの姿は……娘々仮面さん！？: That figure is... the Nio-Nio Mask?!
m920216.あら、ラシティってばズルいですわね。\n今日だけでなくこの後の約束も取り付けるな:
Oh my, Lasithi, you're so sly.
Securing a date for later today, on top of everything else.
m920216.あれは……開拓地で出会った、\nゴブリンの吟遊詩人さん？: That's... the goblin bard we met in the frontier, isn't it?
m920216.あんにゃろ、引っ掻き回すだけ引っ掻き回しやがって！\n次会ったら赤ん坊の頃まで記:
You jerk! You just stir up trouble and leave!
Next time I see him, I'll wipe his memory back to when he was an infant!
m920216.あ？ 大丈夫だろ、あいつ頑丈だし。\nあれぐらいの威力じゃ傷も付かねぇ──:
Huh? He's fine, I'm sure. He's tough as nails.
A hit like that wouldn't even leave a scratch──
m920216.いえ、私はとても良い案だと思いますよ。\nですが観光業の奨励は他国との連携が不可:
No, I think it's a wonderful idea.
However, promoting tourism requires coordination with other nations.
We should probably start laying the groundwork as soon as possible.
m920216.いやぁ、ひとまず大成功ってところかな。\n見た感じ、お客さんの反応も上々みたいだ:
Well, I'd say it was a resounding success for now.
From what I can see, the audience is reacting quite well too—
m920216.いやいやいや、さすがに冗談キツイでしょ。\n武を極めるために俗世は捨てたとか言っ:
No, no, no, that's a bit much, even for a joke.
He said he abandoned the mortal world to perfect his martial arts, and now he's lonely and wants to get married?
m920216.いや待て、少しおかしいぞ。何故、観客がおらんのだ？: Wait, something's off. Why is the stands empty?
m920216.うむ、我は偉大にして至高の大妖怪なれば、\nこの程度のたわむれなどは造作もないこ:
Mm, I am a great and supreme yokai.
A trivial entertainment like this is nothing to me.
m920216.うん、経済が回る予感がするねぇ！\nいやー、エンジュちゃん様々だなー！:
Yeah, I can feel the economy starting to turn!
Man, thanks a lot, Enju-chan!
m920216.うんうん、そうだなー。んじゃ、持ち場に戻れー。: Yeah, yeah, that's the spirit. Alright, back to your posts.
m920216.えぇ……嘘でしょ、何やってんのあの人。: No way... I can't believe it. What is he doing?
m920216.ええと……あの、ウルカノさん？\nマレスさんがピクリとも動かないのですが……。:
Um… I, uh, Vulcano?
Mares isn't moving at all…
m920216.ええと、当の本人はどこに……？: Um, where is the person in question, anyway?
m920216.お、おう。よくやったレジナレア、少し休め。: Y-yeah. Good job, Reginalea. Take a breather.
m920216.おう、マレスの金でな。さっき迎えを出したんだが──: Yeah, Mares is footing the bill. I sent someone to pick them up earlier, but──
m920216.おそらくは次の戦神コロッセウムの準備に向かったのかと。: He likely went to prepare for the next War God Colosseum.
m920216.おっと、丁度到着したみてーだな。: Oh, looks like they just arrived.
m920216.おーう、そこに置いといてくれ。\nあ、武勲結晶の用意も忘れんなよ？:
Yeah, just leave 'em there.
Oh, and don't forget to prep the Merit Crystals.
m920216.お前たちも早くその武器仕舞え！\n『先手必勝！』じゃあねぇんだよ！:
You guys, put your weapons away, too!
It's not like "first strike wins" applies here!
m920216.このまま世界中に、ハッピーを届けに行きましょう♪: Let's go deliver happiness to the whole world♪
m920216.これは、王子の嫁を決める戦いであるッ！！！！: This is the battle to decide the Prince's bride!!!!
m920216.こんなこともあろうかと用意してあります！: I was prepared for exactly this!
m920216.こんな綺麗なドレス、そうそう着れるものではないからね。\nチャンスは積極的に活か:
A dress this beautiful isn't something you get to wear every day.
We'd be wasting a chance if we didn't seize it!
m920216.さ、ぼくたちも次の舞台に移るとしようか。\nヤハールがそろそろ限界みたいだしね。:
Well, let's move on to the next stage.
Yahar seems to be reaching his limit.
m920216.さぁて、それじゃあ演武の時間と行くとしよう。: Well then, let's move on to the demonstration.
m920216.さあ、最高の花嫁さんを見せてあげる！: Now then, let me show you the ultimate bride!
m920216.さっきも言ったろう？ 大事なのは勢いだって。\n遠慮なんてするだけ置いて行かれて:
As I said before? Momentum is key.
If we hold back, we'll only be left behind.
m920216.しかし、この王国の母となるに相応しき者は誰か。\nそれを決める道筋は到底、容易で:
But who is worthy of becoming the mother of this kingdom.
Finding the answer to that is no easy feat…
m920216.しかし、祝祭はこれで終わりではありません。\n今回のジューンブライドは世界を回る:
However, the festival is not over yet.
This June bride is embarking on a world tour.
m920216.せっかくそんな立派な衣裳を着てるんだ。\nあんたの舞いで、ここにいる連中の視線を:
You're wearing such magnificent attire.
Let's steal the eyes of everyone here with your dance.
m920216.そう、四神大集結である！: Yes. The Four Gods have gathered!
m920216.そう、新婚の夫婦が行く旅行のことね。\n古くは里帰りや挨拶回りとして始まったらし:
Yes, it's a trip for newlyweds.
It's said to have started as a way to visit family or pay respects to relatives──
m920216.そういえば今回は祝祭を盛り上げてくださる、\n強力な助っ人の方をお呼びしているの: By the way, we invited some powerful reinforcements to help liven up the festival, right?
m920216.そうですね、おかげさまでうちの子の晴れ舞台を、\n予定よりずっと豪華にしてあげる: Well, thanks to you, we've been able to make my daughter's grand stage much more lavish than planned.
m920216.そこで俺様はかつてない名案を閃いた！: So, I've come up with a brilliant idea!
m920216.そっ、文化の保全ってだけじゃなくて、\n人の流れが増えれば経済も活発になるわ。\:
Well, it's not just about preserving culture.
More travelers mean a more active economy.
Of course, there are plenty of issues, like road safety──
m920216.それじゃあアタシが先導するよ！\nみんな、ちゃんと付いて来てねー！: Then I'll lead the way! Everyone, make sure to follow me!
m920216.それだけじゃない、もう二人いるわ。\n蒼い龍人に、黒髪の拳士ってまさか──:
It's not just them. There are two more.
A blue dragon-person and a black-haired fighter... Could it be...
m920216.それならさ、その余ったお金も使って、\nもっといろんな国を回ってみるのはどう？:
Since we have extra money, why don't we use it to
tour even more countries?
m920216.それ大丈夫？ あたしが乗ったら消し飛ばない？: Is that safe? Won't I blow it away if I get in?
m920216.たとえ花嫁『役』だったとしても、\n王子さまにはこの姿のぼくのことを、\n綺麗で:
Even if I'm just playing the role of a bride,
I want the Prince to think this form of me is
beautiful and cool.
m920216.でかした！ マレスのお金で百年無税！: Well done! No taxes for a hundred years with Mares's money!
m920216.でしょ？ 吟遊詩人さん、車出してもらえる？: Right? Bard, can you lend us your vehicle?
m920216.どうせなら魔界にだって行っちゃってさ。\n世界はもうこんなに元気になったんだよっ:
If we're going to do it, let's even go to the Demon Realm.
Let's tell everyone who isn't here
that the world is thriving again.
m920216.どうにも、打ち所が絶妙だったみたいでなぁ。\nでも、グレる前は実際あんな感じだっ:
Looks like I hit the perfect spot.
But apparently, this was actually how he was before he went off the rails.
m920216.な、なんとか守り抜きましたよ……。: W-we managed to hold on in the end...
m920216.なぁに、吟遊詩人さんもいるし、\nあたしだって手伝ってやるからさ。:
Besides, the bard is here, and
I'll help out too, so don't worry.
m920216.なっ、閉じ込められただと！？ 野郎、まさか──: What? We're locked in?! You bastard, you wouldn't──
m920216.なるほど……ジューンブライドの祝祭に合わせて、\nハネムーンの文化を復活させよう: I see… So, in time with the June Bride Festival, they're trying to revive the honeymoon culture.
m920216.にゃふ、誰に言ってんのさ。: Nyah, who are you talking to?
m920216.にわかには信じられませんが……大丈夫なのですか？: I can hardly believe it… Is he okay?
m920216.ぬらりひょんの娘か。ううむ、やはりやらねばならんかの？: So you're Nurarihyon's daughter. Hmph, I suppose I have no choice but to do this, then?
m920216.ひゅー！ 神様ってやつぁ太っ腹だぜぇぃ！\nコマちゃん！ 今日はお饅頭買って帰り:
Hoo! Gods are really generous, ain't they!
Koma-chan! We're buying some manju on the way home today!
m920216.ふぅん、実は天界でとある噂話を聞いてな。\n王子、どうやら貴様には妃がおらんらし:
Hmm, I actually heard a rumor in the heavens.
It seems you don't have a wife, Prince.
m920216.ふぅん、愚問だなウルカノ。戦神マレスに二言はない。\n一度やると決めたのならば必:
Hmm, a foolish question, Vulcano. The War God Mares does not go back on his word.
If I've decided to do something, I do it. That is who I am.
m920216.ふふっ、ありがと。この後もお祭り楽しんでね？: Hehe, thank you. Enjoy the rest of the festival?
m920216.ふふっ、お褒めに預かり光栄だね。: Hehe, I'm honored by your praise.
m920216.ふふん、お嬢の一番の家臣として、\nあたしが一歩リードってとこかしら？:
Hehe, as the Lady's top retainer,
I think I'm taking the lead, don't you?
m920216.へぇ、すごい立派な建物じゃない。\nこんな場所が華の国にもあったのね。:
Huh, what a grand structure.

Oh, come now. A beautiful Yahar like that
couldn't possibly be an evil presence, could she?
m920216.もちろんです、エンジュ殿。\n今日は我ら妖怪にとっても重要な日。\nどうか貴方の:

We would be grateful for your assistance.
m920216.やあやあ、ようこそ東の国へ。待ってたよー。: Hey hey, welcome to the Eastern Lands. We've been waiting.

m920216.わぁーっ！ すごいすごーい！\nあの花嫁さん、すっごくきれー！:
Waaaah! Amazing, amazing!
That bride is so pretty!
m920216.わざわざ花嫁衣裳まで用意しちゃってさ。\n王子が君より何十も年下ってちゃんと分か:

Does he not realize the Prince is decades younger than him?
Trying to steal his disciple's beloved is just despicable──Whoa!
m920216.ウェディングドレスの美しさを表現するのに、\n最も適した表現方法であるからと聞い: I've been told it's the most fitting way to express the beauty of a wedding dress.
m920216.テメェ！ もう元に戻ってやがったのか！\nこんなところに閉じ込めやがって何する気:
You! You've reverted to your old self, haven't you?
What do you plan to do with us trapped here?!
m920216.デケェ声で喋りやがって城中に聞こえてんだよ！\nディアスよりも先にテメェが王国を:
You're shouting so loud the whole castle can hear you!
Are you trying to destroy the kingdom before Dias does?!
m920216.フハハハハハ！ 戦士たちよ！\n神の獣に、己が力を示すがいい！: Fuhahaha! Warriors! Show the divine beasts what you're made of!
m920216.一応、出資したお金は自由に使えとのことで、\nまだ国家予算レベルの額が余っている:

so there's still a national-budget-level amount left over...
m920216.二人とも、こういうのは勢いが大事なんだよ。: You two, when it comes to this, momentum is everything.

Even if Mares the Demigod's proposal is a bit hasty,
it's certain that the time will come eventually.
It's best to secure the advantage while we can.
m920216.人間と妖怪の共存に必要なことです。: It is essential for the coexistence of humans and yokai.
m920216.今回の祝祭に併せて世界を巡り挑戦者を募り、\n俺様が用意した舞台で立ち合いを行っ:
Alongside this festival, we'll travel the world and recruit challengers.
They will face off in a stage I've prepared.
m920216.仕方ねぇなぁ！ 今回だけは許してやるか！: I guess I can't help it! I'll let it slide this one time!
m920216.俺様は此処に戦神コロッセウム番外編！\n『バトルハネムーン』の開催を宣言する！:
I hereby declare the start of the War God Colosseum Special!
"Battle Honeymoon"!
m920216.全力で、射止めに行かせてもらうよ。: I'll do my best to hit the mark.
m920216.全国のわらしたちー！\n『誰々もやったんだからさ』とか言ってくる、\n悪い大人の:
To all the warashi across the land—!

"Everyone else is doing it, so you should too!"
m920216.分かりました、私の方でも持ち帰って検討を──: Understood. I'll take this back and look into it on my end──

I always thought your black feathers were beautiful, but
white suits you well too. You surprised me.
m920216.前回の戦いはエキシビションマッチでしたからね、\n娘々仮面さんには不完全燃焼だっ:
Our last match was just an exhibition, after all.
Perhaps the Masked Maidens felt they didn't give it their all.
m920216.大方、ドレス姿が恥ずかしくて隠れたんじゃない？\nあの人、ノリで動いて割とすぐに:
She's probably hiding because she's embarrassed by the dress.
She acts on impulse and regrets it almost immediately.
m920216.夫婦に二人の時間をあげる意味合いもあったそうよ。\n世界を巡りながらの特別な思い:
But it was also meant to give the couple some time for themselves.
A special way to make memories while traveling the world.
m920216.妖怪への『畏れ』と『憧憬』の強まりを感じます。\nこれでまた一歩、共存共栄の未来:
I can feel the "awe" and "admiration" for yokai growing stronger.
With this, we take another step toward a future of coexistence and mutual prosperity.

Choosing a consort is part of that duty.

The clanging of empty cans tied to the back is said to
ward off evil spirits.
m920216.愛する者を、想い人をその手で守らんとするならば！\n全力で挑み！ 戦い！ そして:
If you wish to protect your loved ones with your own hands!
You must give it your all! Fight! And you must win!
m920216.我、座敷わらしぞ？\nこの国の者は『わらし』の意味を知らんのか？:
I am a Zashiki-warashi?
Do the people of this country not know what a "warashi" is?
m920216.我は疲れた。茶とせんべえを要求する。: I am tired. I demand tea and senbei.
m920216.戦士よ、王国の戦乙女たちよ！\n貴様らの前に立つは愛の簒奪者！:
Warriors, maidens of war of the Kingdom!
Before you stands the Usurper of Love!
m920216.次は天界だよー！ 遅れないでねー！: Next stop is the Celestial Realm! Don't be late, okay?
m920216.次は華の国だよ！ 出発進行、コケコッコー！: Next stop is the Land of Blossoms! All aboard, cock-a-doodle-doo!
m920216.残念、それはもう一回見てるんだよね。\n私ってば学習する女だからさ──ぐへっ！？:
Too bad, I've seen that move before.
I'm a woman who learns from her mistakes──Guh!
m920216.準備万端よ！ いつでも行けるわ！: Ready as can be! I'm ready to go anytime!
m920216.然して見事に王国を打ち倒した者を王子の妃とする！\nついでにそこで新婚旅行を済ま:
The one who successfully defeats the kingdom becomes the Prince's wife!
And if they finish their honeymoon right there, it's a two-for-one deal!
That is the War God Colosseum Special Edition! Battle Honeym──
m920216.王が後継者を決めずに死んだ国は必ず荒れる。\nどれほど偉大な王であったとしても例:
A kingdom where the king dies without naming an heir is bound to descend into chaos.
No matter how great the king was, there are no exceptions.
m920216.王子さまは……って、聞くまでもないようだね。\n詳しい感想は二人きりのときにお願:
As for the Prince... well, I don't even need to ask.
Could you share your detailed thoughts when we're alone?
m920216.王子と花嫁は吟遊詩人の運転する\nブライダルカーへとご乗車ください。:
Prince and bride, please board the bridal car,
which the bard will be driving.
m920216.皆さん、素晴らしい演武をありがとうございました。: Everyone, thank you for the magnificent performance.
m920216.皆様、長旅ご苦労様でした。\nエンジュ殿、今日はよろしくお願いしますね。:
Everyone, you must be tired after the long journey.
Lord Enju, we look forward to your cooperation today.
m920216.知らねぇけど、たぶん大丈夫だろ。\nせっかく祭りの手伝いしてくれるってんだ、\n:
No idea, but he's probably fine.
Since he's helping out with the festival, let's just milk him for his trouble before his memory comes back.
m920216.祝祭のトリを飾るのに相応しい──\nおっと、カーニアが伝染っちゃった。:
A fitting venue to close out the festival──
Oh, I've caught it from Kania.
m920216.祭りと言ったら歌と音楽だろ？\nヤハール！ 準備できてるかー！？:
A festival's not a festival without song and music, right?
Yahar! Are you all set?
m920216.祭りの縁起物として呼ばれたかと思えば、\nまさか我自身が花嫁役になるとはなぁ……:
I thought I was invited as a lucky charm for the festival,
but to think I'd be playing the bride...
m920216.立ち直り早ぇなコイツ。: She bounces back fast, that one.
m920216.結婚式用に特別に飾り付けた車よ。\n昔は馬車なんか使っていたみたいね。:
It's a vehicle specially decorated for the wedding.
They used to use horse carriages back in the day.
m920216.自分がいたら邪魔だろうからって、裏に引っ込んでるぜ。: He said he'd be in the way, so he's hiding in the back.

m920216.誰かおせんべい買ってきてー！ 駆け足！: Someone go buy some senbei! Run for it!

You may be an excellent commander, but
as a ruler, you're failing miserably in that regard.
m920216.赤い鳥人に白い獣人って……\n武王大宴でも戦った朱雀と白虎かい？:
A red bird-person and a white beast-person...
Are those the Vermilion Bird and the White Tiger we fought at the King of Wu's Banquet?
m920216.鎖骨……鎖骨折れた……ッ！: My collarbone... my collarbone is broken...!
m920216.開幕から絶好チョーだね！？: Perfect timing for the opening, huh!?
m920216.魔物の復活で一度は文化が途絶えちゃったけど、\n最近は世界各国でも復興が進んでい:
The resurgence of monsters interrupted the tradition for a while, but
haven't you seen it making a comeback in countries around the world lately?
m920216.鳥ギャグばっか言ってる自分が恥ずかしくなるよー！: It makes me embarrassed to realize I've been nothing but bird puns...
m920216.（……またセンシティブな話題を）: (…Why does he always bring up sensitive topics?)
m920216.（あのマレスが……珍しくまともなことを）: (That Mares… is actually saying something sensible.)
m920216.（妖怪って怖いイメージだったけど、\nそれ以上に神秘的で雅やかなんだな……）:
(I always thought yokai were scary,
but they're actually more mysterious and graceful...)
m920216.（妻と行けなかった新婚旅行……\n今からでも遅くはないかもしれんな……）:
(The honeymoon trip I couldn't take with my wife...
It might not be too late to go now...)
m920216.（馬鹿な、マレス様にそんな気遣いできるはずが……！？）: (Ridiculous... how could Mares-sama be so considerate...?!)

—This is the last line of defense!
We can't retreat any further!

――I thought you'd just ignore me.
I was about to start some demolition on my own.
m920221.――これは、本当に時間稼ぎなんだろうさ。: —This is truly just a stalling tactic.

――This is a historic discovery…
Anabella, Felicia, Colette!
Start collecting the materials, but don't read the contents!!

――No need for that.
They're coming our way.
Prince! The guard golems are on the move!
m920221.――その戦、助力させてもらえないか。: ――May I lend a hand in that battle?

――Tch, no end to them!
Can't we do anything about that teleportation magic!?

Is this all the strength of the Kingdom's god-slaying army?

――Phew, there we go…….
How's it going, Heraclea? Is it all clear?
m920221.――まぁいいや。\nペルセナスに話しても理解してくれないだろうし。:
――Never mind.
You wouldn't understand even if I explained it to you.
m920221.――ようやく来たか、王国軍。: ――So you've finally arrived, the Kingdom's army.

――Hermerk, why did you decide to help us?
Did your heart of justice finally awaken?
m920221.――レクテ、改修作業の進捗は！？: ――Rekte, what's the status of the repairs?
m920221.――人類を守る。\nそのために、今こそ、目覚めてください。:
――To protect humanity.
For that reason, awaken now.

—But it's different now.
I... Paruse can fight alongside you.
To stand on the battlefield together, for the things we want to protect.

A large number of Holy Knights have appeared, heading for the capital!
The defense forces have made contact!

Tch…… When the commander changes,
is this how much more tragic it gets?

――I'm overwhelmed…….
We're flying, we're actually flying…….

――My name is Heraclea.
Step forward if you wish to die.

――The Kingdom's flagship airship!
A fusion of the super-ancient civilization's vessel, the Heavenly Rock Ship, and the divine beast Unicorn!
The world's newest and most powerful aerial battleship!
m920221.――王子、魔術ギルドからの報告です。\n現在、王都から離れた地点に、\n複数の転:
――Prince, a report from the Magic Guild.
Multiple instances of teleportation magic have been detected
at a location far from the capital.
m920221.――皆さん！ 飛空戦艦に搭乗を！\nまだ接続は完全ではありませんが、\nこのまま:
――Everyone! Board the flying warship!
The connection isn't fully complete yet,
but we're going to force it to fly!

—All units, take combat positions!
I'm going out to the battlefield too. I'll leave the attack orders to you, Prince.
m920221.――退け。\n戦士でない者を殺す趣味はない。:
――Step aside.
I have no taste for killing those who cannot fight.
m920221.…………。\nさぁヘラクレイア、一騎打ちです。\n私に勝てると思っているなら、か:
…………
Very well, Heraklia. It's a duel.
If you think you can beat me, then come at me.
m920221.…………はぁ。\nまた頭痛の種が増えたぞ、まったく。:
…………Haa.
Another headache added to the pile. Truly.
m920221.…………ん。\nこの匂い……戦士の気配だ。:
…………Hm.
This scent…… it's the aura of a warrior.
m920221.…………ッ！？\nなんだ、この振動は……まさか、この巨艦が！？:
…………Huh!?
What is this vibration…… could it be, this battleship is!?
m920221.…………繋がりました。\nこの子は、飛べます。王子、命令をお願いします。:
…………I've connected.
This one can fly. Prince, please give the order.
m920221.……こちらの味方につく、というのですか？: ...You're saying you'll fight on our side?
m920221.……それがさ、\n一番大事な作業が終わってないんだよねぇ。:
……Well, you see,
the most important part isn't finished yet.
m920221.……ただ、問題はそこまで待つことができないということ。\nディアスの目覚めは、そ:

Dias's awakening means a crisis for the Material World.
m920221.……なぜ、こちらに？\n私の破壊が目的なら、\n手薄な飛空戦艦本体を狙ってくるの:
...Why are they targeting us?
If destroying me is their goal,
they should be aiming for the vulnerable main body of the Sky Battleship.

...I see. Their goal is to stall for time.
If that's the case, hesitating here
would only play into their hands.
m920221.……なんだァ、あれ？\nただの天界兵だってのに、「神」の気配がするぜ。:
...What is that?
They're just ordinary Celestial Soldiers,
but I can feel the aura of a "god."
m920221.……む？\n何でしょう、この異様な魔力の波動は……。:
...Hm?
What is this strange magical fluctuation...?
m920221.……もう少し、時間をください。\n先の起動実験の時よりも、\n私の言うことを聞い:
...Please give me a little more time.
It's listening to me better
than it did during the previous activation test, but...
m920221.……ガレアか。なぜだ？\nこの船を破壊するのが目的じゃないのか。:
……Galea? Why?
Isn't destroying this ship the objective?
m920221.……ッ！ この耳鳴り……！\n要塞宮殿の転移魔法です！ 新手が来ます！:
……Ugh! This ringing in my ears……!
It's the Fortress Palace's teleportation magic!
Reinforcements are arriving!
m920221.……使えそうなパーツの反応があります。\nちょうど破壊された整流装置の――すごい:
……I'm picking up signatures from usable parts.

these look like an upgraded version!

……The Celestial Soldiers have vanished—no, they teleported.
It was a teleportation spell of terrifyingly high output.
m920221.……敵の攻勢が止まらない。\n連中、戦法を変えてきたな。:
……The enemy's assault isn't slowing down.
Looks like they've changed their tactics.
m920221.……暁をもたらす者。\n夜を割き、神秘の時代を終わらせ、人の時代へ至る者。:

The one who splits the night, ends the age of mystery, and leads us into the age of man.

The enemy is heading straight for us.

the Prince and his allies are the ones who met the victory conditions.

What?

—Initiate the defense of the capital.
Issue a general mobilization order across the entire Kingdom.
m920221.ああ。世界の敵になった以上、\nもう滅ぼすか、滅ぼされるかしかないだろう。:
Indeed. Now that they have become the world's enemy,
it is either destroy them or be destroyed.
m920221.あいあい！\nエピウス、そっち手伝いに行くよ！:
Aye aye!

Yeah, leave it to me.

Yes, I feel wonderful.

Yes, it's only natural.

m920221.えぇと、うわ、想像もできません……。: Um, wow... I can't even imagine it...

Easy, easy. Hold on a second.

Oh, Koharu!

Oh-ho!

Now then, who's going?

We'll land the ship right before the fortress.

Beyond the blue sky that covers this land.
Past the canopy that shifts into a deep indigo.

Is it possible this opening is intentional?

This should buy us some time, at least.

*gulp*...

Well now…… who knows what's going on outside.

Come on then, Holy Knights!

Then we just need to take them down quickly!
Come on, Prince! Let's mow them all down!!

Now then, how long will this defensive line hold…….

m920221.さて、それじゃあ準備を進めよう。\nあまり時間はない、王国すべての力が必要だ。:
Well then, let's get ready.

Now then, you Celestial Soldiers, fall back!

I see.

We will not let a single one of those Holy Knights escape.

And the prime example of that is Prineas.
Ah, and Colette is in the same boat.

I know that much!

Ephtra, Arlette, could you tell the Prince?

Besides, right now, I want to conserve mana

That's not a request I can accept.

I-I'm sure it'll be fine...

And our battlefield is

How does it look?

I see. By dispersing the mana cannon's output,

Haha, indeed.

Hmph, a divine beast……?

Now, now, leave it to me.

m920221.まっ、焦りは失敗のママだし！\nここはひとつひとつ、原因を探っていって――:
Well, rushing only leads to failure!

We're all with you.

m920221.むしろあちらの戦力を考えれば、\n同時襲撃もありえるはずですが……。:
Given their forces,

Good. We'll use that time to regroup.
Prince, prepare for the counterattack!

Very well, then—All units, begin the march!

All right, everyone, prepare to engage.

Alright, let's show those enemies who came to surround us

Understood!

W-Whoa… M-Monsters!

Oh, you can't be up yet!

m920221.わっ、わわわっ、い、急ぎましょう！\n一大事！ 一大事ですー！！:
W-w-wait, let's hurry!
This is a major crisis! A major crisis!!
m920221.わー！ わー！ わー！？\nま、大気中の魔力がめちゃくちゃにぃ！？:
Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!?
Th-The mana in the atmosphere is going haywire!?
m920221.ん……？ 当たり前のことだろ？: Hm……? Isn't that just how it should be?
m920221.ん、どうしたんだ王子、にやにやしやがって。: Hm? What's with you, Prince, grinning like that?
m920221.ん？ どしたの？ ――名前？\nあっ、あぁ！ この子の名前は！？\n起動命令出せ:
Hm? What's wrong? ――The name?
Ah, that's it! What's this one's name!?
I can't issue the startup command!
m920221.アマツは特に、磐船との\n動力伝達に使うパーツをお願いします。\nできれば、現状:
Amatsu, please focus on the parts for the power transmission
between the Iwafune and the rest.
Ideally, something sturdier than what we have now.
m920221.ガレアは飛空戦艦の完成は防げないと読んだんだ。\nだからこそ、破壊できないのなら:
Gaea must have realized that completing the Sky Battleship is inevitable.
So, if they can't destroy it,
they've decided to buy time until their countermeasures are ready.
m920221.ディアスへの祈りの言葉、か。\nあんなもの、戦場の作法だと思うだろう、普通は！:
The words of prayer to Dias, you say.
Normally, one would assume that's just battlefield protocol!
m920221.ディアス様との契約は、ここまでだ。\n各々、託された使命はあるが……。:
My contract with Lord Dias ends here.
We each have our own duties, but……
m920221.ドーンブリンガーの大砲で、\nどかーんと何とかなりませんか？:
Couldn't we just blast them to smithereens
with the Dawnbringer's cannons?
m920221.パルセ、大丈夫……？\n飛べそう……？:
Paruse, are you okay……?
Do you think it can fly……?
m920221.パルセ、船との接続はどうだ？\n起動できそうか？:
Paruse, how's the connection with the ship?
Do you think we can activate it?
m920221.パルセ！ もういい！\n僕のことは捨てて早く逃げ――:
Paruse! Enough!
Forget about me and run!
m920221.パーツは豊富にありますが、\nここの在庫だけでは、まだたりなさそうです……。:
The stock here is plentiful,
but it still won't be enough with just this location…
m920221.ヘラクレイアも追走を諦めたみたい。\n全力で走っても追いつきようがないしね。:
Herakleia seems to have given up on chasing us.
Even at full speed, there's no way we could catch up.
m920221.ペルセナス、気付いてないのかい？\n自由を愛する僕が、\n自由気ままに物質界を旅:
Persenas, you haven't noticed, have you?
For me, who loves freedom, to travel the Material Plane as I please—
m920221.レクテ……。\n可哀想に、可愛い顔が緩みきって台無しに。:
Rekte…….
What a shame. That lovely face is completely slack.
m920221.ロベルト殿！ こちらに負傷者が！\nお急ぎくだされ！:
Lord Robert! We have wounded over here!
Please come quickly!
m920221.了解。\n払暁級戦艦一番艦、ドーンブリンガー……起動します。:
Understood.
First ship of the Daybreak-class battleship, Dawnbringer…… initiating.
m920221.人には悪いことをしようと思って悪事を働く輩もいる。\nでも、亜神というのは己を律:
Humans have those who deliberately choose to do evil.
But demigods act on what we deem correct,
bound by our own laws and powers.
m920221.今もクリッサとホリーが語りかけてくれてるんだけど、\nうーん、やっぱり神獣の頭脳:
Crissa and Holly are trying to communicate with it right now,
but, hmm, maybe even a divine beast's mind
can't handle such a heavy computational load…….
m920221.仲間にしてくれ、などとは言わない。\nただ……ジメネス、あいつの首だけは、私が落:
I won't ask to be taken in as an ally.
But... Jimenez. I will take that man's head myself.
m920221.何者かが、あの戦士たちに神の力を与えているんだ。\n放っておけばさらに力を増して:
Someone is imbuing those warriors with divine power.
If we leave them alone, they'll only grow stronger.
m920221.使い捨てどころか、\n自分から雷霆で抹殺しにかかるかもね。:
Not just disposable.
He might even try to obliterate them with his own thunder.
m920221.例外、か……。\nなるほど、悪くない気分だ。\n人間だったころの感情が蘇ってくる:
An exception, huh…….
I see, that's not a bad feeling.
It brings back the emotions I had when I was human.
m920221.僕は人の気持ちとかいうものが察せないらしいからな。\nここは昔からの王国のやり方:
Apparently, I'm terrible at reading people's feelings.
I'll leave it all to the Strategist of the Hidden Dragon,
who knows the Kingdom's ways from the old days.
m920221.全部終わったらミネット商店で打ち上げしよ！\n期間限定にゃんにゃかスイーツ！:
Once we're all done,
let's celebrate at Minette's Shop!
They have limited-time Nyan-Nyan sweets!
m920221.冗談です。\nですが、全軍を焼き払うほどの魔力を行使すれば、\n少なくとも地形が:
I'm joking.
However, if we exert enough mana to burn down their entire army,
it would cause at least enough damage to alter the terrain.
m920221.出力調整さえ完了すれば、\n何の問題もなく、あの空の向こうにだって行けますよ。:
Once we finish adjusting the output,
we can head to the other side of that sky without any problems.
m920221.分かっているとも。\nそれぞれが、それぞれに正しいと思ったことをする、\nその点:
I know.
Whether human or demigod,
we all just do what we believe is right, don't we?
m920221.初めてなので、不安ではありますが……。\nそれでも、ドーンブリンガーができると言:
It's my first time, so I'm a bit nervous...
But I've been told the Dawnbringer can do it.
m920221.初めての……敗北、だな。\nああ……契約は果たされたよ、ディアス。\n私は敗北し:
My first…… defeat, I see.
Ah…… the contract has been fulfilled, Dias.
I was defeated, but I got the fight I wanted!
--- scene: The One Who Brings Dawn ---
m920221.前騎士団長が、最後の歯止めだったね。\nおそらくジメネスは、騎士団員すべての自我:
The former Knight Commander was the last check on them.
Jimenes has likely stripped every knight of their self-will,
turning them into complete puppets.
m920221.助かります。\nクリッサさん、ホリーさん、\n引き続きサポートをお願いします。:
Thank you.
Clissa, Holly,
please continue supporting us.
m920221.半信半疑でしたが……ヘルメルクが\n協力してくれるというのは、\n嘘ではなかった: I was skeptical, but… it seems Hermerk really is willing to help.
m920221.同意をいただいたと判断します。\n――磐船機関、圧縮開始。:
I'll take that as your consent.
――Iwafune mechanism, begin compression.
m920221.向こうには無尽蔵の魔力があります！\nせめて、要塞宮殿との接続を、\n一瞬でも断:
They have an inexhaustible supply of mana!
If we could just sever the connection to the Fortress Palace, even for a moment, we might buy some time...
m920221.君なら予想して、対策までしてくると思ったんだけどね。\nなにしろ、これは転移魔法:
I assumed you would have predicted it and prepared a counter.
After all, this isn't a teleportation spell.
It's a pseudo-recreation of the summoning magic stolen from the Goddess Aigis.
m920221.君の強さは知っている。\nでも、ここは僕の計略に乗ってくれないかい？:
I know how strong you are.
But won't you fall for my little scheme?
m920221.周辺空域の魔力を、大規模に乱せば良いのですね？: We simply need to disrupt the mana in the surrounding airspace on a large scale, yes?
m920221.団長さん、そんな言葉聞いたら、\n部下のみなさんが悲しみますよ？:
Commander, if your subordinates hear you say that,
they'll be heartbroken.
m920221.大丈夫だ。\nその時間を稼ぐのが僕らの仕事だからな。\n思いっきり甘えてくれ。:
It's fine.
Buying you that time is our job.
Rely on us as much as you need.
m920221.天界兵の増援が途切れた。\n王子、今が好機だよ。:
The reinforcements of Celestial Soldiers have stopped.
Prince, now is our chance.
m920221.女神アイギスより賜りし、我が使命は人類の守護。\n神獣から人型になってもそれは変:
My mission, granted by the Goddess Aigis, is the protection of humanity.
That hasn't changed, even now that I've taken human form.
m920221.好き勝手言ってくれる……！\n時間稼ぎだとか言っておきながら、\n戦いを楽しみ過:
Talk about talking big……!
She claims she's just buying time,
but that woman is enjoying the fight way too much!
m920221.嬉しくもなりますよ。\nだって、みんなが自分で考えて、\nなすべきことの為に全力:
It's hard not to feel happy.
Everyone is thinking for themselves
and giving it their all for what needs to be done.
m920221.幻獣ユニコーンもやる気になってます。\n必ず成功させましょう！:
The Phantom Beast Unicorn is feeling motivated too.
Let's make sure this succeeds!
m920221.当たり前だ。\n僕の仕事は皆に気持ちよく戦争してもらうことだぞ。\n彼女らの戦場:
Of course.
My job is to make sure everyone fights comfortably.
Their battlefield right now is preparing the Sky Battleship for activation.
m920221.彼らが、一騎当千の強者ってことですか！？: Does that mean they're all warriors capable of defeating a thousand men?!
m920221.待てぇぇぇッ！！\nガレア、やはり貴様か！！:
Waiiiit!!
Galea, so it was you all along!!
m920221.怪我人に発言権はありません。\n私をかばって負傷した大馬鹿天才はお黙りを。:
A wounded person has no right to speak.
Keep quiet, you reckless genius who got hurt shielding me.
m920221.悪いね、今取り込み中なんだ。\n襲撃は後日にしてもらえる？:
Sorry, I'm in the middle of something.
Can we postpone the attack for another day?
m920221.想定通り……だが、早すぎるな。戦況は？: As expected……but this is earlier than anticipated. What's the situation?
m920221.我々は、単純な契約関係に過ぎない。\n私の場合は、ただ、\n半神となる試練を与え:
We are bound by nothing more than a simple contract.
In my case, I am merely repaying the debt
for bestowing upon me the trial to become a demigod.
m920221.手分けして使えそうなパーツを探しましょう。\nエピウス、アマツ、手伝ってもらえま:
Let's split up and look for usable components.
Epeius, Amatsu, can you help us out?
m920221.数時間から、数日程度が限界かと。: A few hours to a few days, I'd say.
m920221.来る……王子は必ず来てくれる。\n総員、諦めるな！:
He's coming... The Prince will surely come.
Everyone, don't give up!
m920221.正確には、言葉を聞いてくれるようになったかな。\nあとはパルセが、自分を説き伏せ:
To be precise, it's started listening to words.
All Paruse has to do now is convince it to come along.
m920221.殿軍はお任せを。\n我々砂漠の民には、地の利がありますから。:
Leave the rearguard to us.
As desert folk, we have the advantage of the terrain.
m920221.気付いていて襲撃を防げないとは、\n常勝の智将の勘も鈍ったのかな？:
So you noticed, yet you still couldn't stop the ambush.
Has the instinct of the undefeated strategist dulled?
m920221.気分、気分か……。\nなるほど、そいつぁいい。:
Feeling like it, huh...
I see. That's good.
m920221.片付け中に読み始めるとそのまま朝まで\n読み耽るからじゃないですかねー。:
Well, if you start reading while you're sorting them,
you'll end up glued to the pages until morning.
m920221.王国にとって、神聖騎士団は明確な敵だ。\n何なら物質界全体にとっての敵と言い切っ:
To the kingdom, the Holy Knights are a clear enemy.
You could even say they are an enemy to the entire Material World.
m920221.王国の王子、貴様の実力を私に見せてくれ。\n私はまだ高みを目指せると、人類の可能:
Prince of the Kingdom, show me your true strength.
Prove to me that humanity still has the potential to reach greater heights.
m920221.王子、このまま王都へ進路を取ります。\nすぐに到着しますので、戦闘準備をお願いし:
Prince, we are heading straight for the capital.
We will arrive shortly, so please prepare for battle.
m920221.王子、向こうにはこの前と同じ、\n「神」の気配の混じった兵がいる。\nいつもの神:
Prince, the enemy forces ahead have that same "divine" presence mixed in as before.
I think they're the usual Holy Knights!
--- scene: The Bringer of Dawn (battle, end) ---
m920221.王子、敵が来るよ！\n迎撃準備を！:
Prince, the enemy is coming!
Prepare to intercept!
m920221.王子、王城が見えました。\n敵はすでに、王都付近の砦まで侵攻している模様です。:
Prince, the royal capital is in sight.
The enemy has already advanced
to the fortresses near the capital.
m920221.王子、発射命令を。: Prince, give the order to fire.
m920221.王子、魔力砲を撃ちます。\nトリガーをお任せしたいのですが、よろしいですか？:
Prince, I'm going to fire the mana cannon.
I'd like to leave the trigger to you. Is that all right?
m920221.甲板に出てみる？\n防護はされてるけど、たぶん吹き飛ばされそうになれるよ。:
Want to come out to the deck?
There's some protection, but you'll probably feel like you're about to be blown away.
m920221.申し遅れた。\n元神聖騎士団長、雷神の騎士、マージだ。:
Apologies for the late introduction.
I am Marge, former Grandmaster of the Holy Knights and Knight of the Thunder God.
m920221.目的は時間稼ぎだからね。\nそれに、君をここで失うと計画に支障が出る。:
The objective is simply to buy time.
Besides, if you're lost here, it will disrupt the plan.
m920221.直接乗り込めないから、\n周囲で部隊を整えて進軍してくるつもりか……。:
They can't strike directly, so they're
gathering their forces nearby and preparing to advance…….
m920221.砂漠どころか、\n世界中のあらゆる場所に埋まっているよ。\n大半はプロメが溶かし:
It's not just the desert, you know.
They're buried all over the world.
Most of them were melted down by Prome, though.
m920221.砂漠にも超古代文明の遺跡があったんですね……。: So there were hyper-ancient ruins in the desert too…
m920221.磐船、ユニコーンは大丈夫！\n動力伝達の調整がメインだからね！\n船体部分だけ被:
The Rock Ship and Unicorn are fine!
It's mostly just adjusting the power transmission!
The hull took the worst of the damage,
so it's going to take a while!
m920221.磐船の出力は安定してる。\n船体への動力伝達も完璧。\nあとは、管理頭脳であるパ:
The Rock Ship's output is stable.
Power transmission to the hull is perfect.
Now, Paruse, the management brain, just needs to take command of the ship.
m920221.神の加護を受けている……？\nいや、もっと異質な……。:
They're under divine protection...?
No, it feels even more alien than that...
m920221.神の座を拒否した男、王国の王子。\n真逆の道を選んだお前の剣技、見せてもらう。:
The man who refused the seat of a god, the Prince of the Kingdom.
Show me the swordsmanship of one who chose the exact opposite path.
m920221.神獣……いや、もっと大きな……。\nこれは――皆、空だ！ 向こうの空から！:
A divine beast... no, something even bigger...
It's— everyone, look at the sky! From the sky over there!
m920221.神聖騎士団は、おそらく総力を挙げて攻撃してくる。\n現状、連中が生き残るには、\:
The Holy Knights will likely attack with their full strength.
At this point, if they want to survive,
they have no choice but to annihilate the kingdom.
m920221.私の使命とは、この武力をもって\n飛空戦艦を破壊すること。:
My duty is to use this power
to destroy the Sky Battleship.
m920221.私の生まれた時代では、\nその空域のことを「宇宙」と呼んでいました。:
In the era I was born in,
we called that region of the sky "space."
m920221.私の言葉が、届いていますか？\nこれはあなたの言葉です。\n私とあなたは、同じ願:
Can you hear my words?
These are your words.
You and I were born for the same wish.
m920221.私の設計担当のひとりじゃないですか。\n力を貸してください。:
Aren't you one of the people in charge of my designs?
Please lend me your strength.
m920221.空の……向こう……？: The other side of…… the sky……?
m920221.空戦は少々心配ですが、\n私個人が戦場に出る分には問題ありません。:
I'm a bit worried about aerial combat,
but there's no problem with me personally joining the battle.
m920221.義理を果たしに来ただけだよ。\n王子には世話になってるし。:
I'm just here to repay a debt.
The Prince has been kind to me.
m920221.船体が完成したのに、\nまだ作業が残っているのですか？:
The hull is complete,
but there's still work left to do?
m920221.襲撃があることを前提に防衛線を構築したので、\nどうにか押し留めることには成功し:
We established the defense line assuming an attack,
so we've managed to hold them off for now. However,
the enemy is Living Armor, which knows no fatigue……
m920221.要塞宮殿は、天界側の時空で、\n宇宙と空の境界線上にあると推測されています。\n:
The Fortress Palace is believed to exist
on the boundary between space and the sky,
in the celestial realm's spacetime.
Even if you can't imagine it,
we'll be heading there eventually.
m920221.誰もが疲れ切った世界では、\nただ、英雄という願いを皆が追いかけるもの。:
In a world where everyone is exhausted,
the hero is merely a wish that everyone chases.
m920221.負ける、と言いたいのか。\n半神となったこの身が。:
Are you saying you'll lose?
With this body that has become semi-divine?
m920221.負傷者はいるか！？\nここで戦死なんざ許さねぇからな！:
Are there any casualties?!
I won't allow anyone to die in battle here!
m920221.超古代文明の船も、磐船のエネルギーを得て、\nいつでも飛べる状態にあります。:
The ship of the super-ancient civilization has gained the energy of the Rock Ship.
It is ready to fly at any moment.
m920221.超高出力な磐船、頑丈ででっかいユニコーン、\n飛行能力を担う超古代文明の船、\n:
The ultra-high-output Rock Ship, the sturdy, massive Unicorn,
and the super-ancient vessel that provides flight capabilities—
we can't get the connection to the central intelligence that integrates all of them to work properly.
m920221.身体のことなら、気にしないでくれ。\nいつ死んでも構わないと思っている。:
??? : Don't worry about my body.
I don't care if I die.
m920221.転移魔法を感知！\n敵が来ます！！:
Detecting teleportation magic!
The enemy is coming!!
m920221.重傷だ、正直動きたくない！\nそれよりアキレア、船体を破壊している天界兵を潰せ！:
I'm badly injured, I honestly don't want to move!
But first, Achillea, take out those Celestial Soldiers wrecking the ship!
m920221.開戦前には、いつも「ディアスの加護を！」って\n祈りを捧げていたんだから、僕が加:
Before every battle, I always offered the prayer, "Bless us, Dias!"
I'm sure you realized that the one granting me that protection was Lord Dias.
m920221.間違いありません。\nこれは……超古代文明時代の造船ドックです。:
You're right.
This is… a shipyard from the hyper-ancient era.
m920221.面白い冗談だ、ベルナール殿。\nこの場には、ひとりたりとも\n神聖騎士団を恐れる:
An amusing joke, Lord Bernard.
There is not a single person here
who fears the Holy Knights.
m920221.飛空戦艦が起動したのか！: The flying warship has started up!
m920221.飛空戦艦にっ、敵がっ！\n天界兵の襲撃です！！:
Enemies are on the air battleship!
It's an assault by Celestial soldiers!!
m920221.魔力砲弾、磐船内で正常加圧中。\n一角獣式魔力砲、\n拡散モードに設定、バレルオ:
The mana shell is pressurizing normally inside the Iwafune.
Unicorn-type mana cannon,
set to dispersion mode. Barrel open.
m920221.魔術ギルドの総力で編み上げた転移妨害魔法だぞ！\nそれをぶち破ってくる奴がいると:
We wove this teleportation interference spell using the full power of the Magic Guild!
For someone to just smash right through it—
who on earth could have predicted that?
m920221.魔術ギルドの総力をあげた妨害魔術を貫いてくるとは。\n亜神ディアスの転移魔術は凄:
To pierce through our full-scale interference magic...
The teleportation magic of the demigod Dias is formidable.
m920221.魔術ギルドの転移妨害魔法にも反応なしです！\nいえ……これは……まさか、無効化さ:
No reaction to the Magic Guild's anti-teleportation wards either!
No…… this is…… could they have been disabled?!
m920221.魔術ギルドより報告！\n複数の転移魔術の反応あり！ 神聖騎士団です！:
Report from the Magic Guild!
Multiple teleportation magic reactions detected! It's the Holy Knights!
m920221.（……あの人、この前私の家を\n襲撃してきたヘルメルク本人ですよね？\nどうして:
(…That person is the very Hermerk
who attacked my home recently, isn't it?
Why is he being so cooperative?)
m920221.（亜神に筋の通った理由を求める方が無理な話だよ。\nセリド、君だって自覚、あるん:
(It's futile to expect a logical reason from a demi-god.
Serid, don't you realize that too?)
m920221.（娘のことになると\n突然挙動不審になるものね、セリドお母さん？）:
(Mothers do become a bit erratic
when it comes to their daughters, don't they, Serid?)
